text: Ku wa mbere, abahinga bo kuri kaminuza yitwa Stanford University School of Medicine baratangaje yuko habonetse igikoresho gishasha co gupima indwara gishobora gutandukanya uturemangingo bivanye n'ubwoko bwatwo: ni agakoresho gato cane ka elegitoronike gashobora guhingurwa hakoreshejwe imashini zicapura zirekura irangi, bigashobora gutwara nk'ic'ijana c'idolari rimwe ry'Abanyamerika.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Abashakashatsi nyamukuru bavuga ko ako gakoresho gashobora gufasha gutora ningoga kanseri, igituntu, SIDA na malariya ku barwayi bo mu bihugu vy'amikoro make, aho ushobora gusanga ibitigiri vy'abahitanwa n'indwara nka kanseri y'ibere biruta incuro zibiri abo mu bihugu bitunze.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Imyiyerekano yatanguye nk'isaha 11:00 zaho (UTC+1) kw'ibarabara rya Whitehall, aharabana n'ubwinjiriro bucunzwe n'abapolisi bw'ibarabara rya Downing Street ribako umushikiranganji wa mbere.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Inyuma gato y'isaha 11:00, abari mu myiyerekano barazibiye uruja n'uruza rw'ingendeshwa zija mu buraruko aho i Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Isaha 11:20, igipolisi caciye gisaba abari mu myiyerekano kwigirwa inyuma ku mapave, kibabwira yuko naho bafise uburenganzira bwo kugira imyiyerekano, batozibira uruja n'uruza.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Nk'isaha 11:29, abari mu myiyerekano baraduganye ibarabara rya Whitehall, bararengana i Trafalgar Square baca kw'ibarabara rya Strand, barengana hafi y'i Aldwych badugana irya Kingsway bagana Holborn, aho umugambwe w'aba Conservateurs wariko ugirira ikoraniro ryawo ryo mpeshi mw'ihoteri Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: "Panama Papers" ni izina rikoreshwa muri rusangi bashaka kuvuga inzandiko imiliyoni nka cumi ishirahamwe ry'abashingwamanza ryo muri Panama ryitwa Mossack Fonseca ryahishuriye ibimenyeshamakuru muri Ndamukiza 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Izo nzandiko zaravuze amabanki cumi n'ane yafashije abakiriya bayo b'abatunzi kunyegeza amadolari amamiliyaridi y'amanyamerika mu ntumbero yo guhesha amakori n'ayandi mategeko.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Ikinyamakuru The Guardian co mu Bwongereza cavuze ko ibanki Deutsche Bank yoba yaritwararika ica gatatu c'amashirahamwe 1200 yo guhuma amaso abantu yakoreshejwe muri iyo ntumbero.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Ikiganiro PBS caronse ubushimwe mirongo ibiri na bune bwitiriwe Emmy, kandi umwanya kimara ni muto ugereranije na Sesame Street na Mister Roger’s Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Agace kose k’ikiganiro kashimikira ku mutwe w’ijambo mu gitabo kanaka maze kagaca irya n'ino uwo mutwe biciye mu nkuru nyinshi.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant wo muri WNED Buffalo (aho ikiganiro Reading Rainbow catanguriye) yavuze ati: "Ikiganiro Reading Rainbow carigishije abana igituma bosoma,... kibakundisha gusoma — kiremesha abana gutora igitabu bagasoma."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Bamwebamwe, harimwo John Grant, biyumvira ko ingorane z’ubutunzi n’ihinduka ry'ivyiyumviro mu bijanye n'ugutanga inyigisho biciye ku mboneshakure vyaterereye mu kurangiza amareresi.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ico gihuhusi cabereye nko ku mayire 645 (ibilometero 1040 mu burengero bw'amazinga ya Cap Vert. Abaraba ivy'ikirere bavuga ko gishobora guhera kitaragira ahandi hantu conona ku butaka.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Ubu, imiyaga y'igihuhusi Fred ifise umuvuduko wa mayiri 105 kw'isaha (ibilometero 165 kw'isaha), kikaba kiriko kija mu buraruko bushira uburengero.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred ni co kivumbuzi co mu mihingo ishushe y'isi gikaze kuruta ibimaze kuba mu bumanuko no mu buseruko bwa Atalantike kuva mu haje amasanamu ya satelite, kikaba na co gihuhusi gikomeye ca gatatu kibaye mu buseruko bwa 35° mu burengero.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Ku wa 24 Nyakanga 1759, Arthur Guinness yarasinye amasezerano yo gupanga y'imyaka 9.000 ku bw'ihinguriro ry'inzoga ryitwa St James' Gate Brewery i Dublin muri Irilande.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Inyuma y'imyaka 250, Guinness isagaye ari ishirahamwe rizwi kw'isi yose ryinjiza amahera y'amanyaburaya arenga imiliyaridi 10 (imiliyaridi 14,7 y'amadolari) buri mwaka.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, umushoferi-mufasha wo mu mugwi wa A1GP wo muri Nouvelle Zélande, uyu musi yakoze ikintu c'akataraboneka mu kunyonga umuduga ningoga gusumba abandi bose ku kiraro kirenza imyaka 48 citwa Auckland Harbour Bridge, muri Nouvelle Zélande, mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Umushingantahe Reid yashoboye kunyonga umuduga witwa «Black Beauty» w'umugwi A1GP wo muri Nouvelle Zélande, ku mivuduko irenga ibilometero 160 kw'isaha incuro indwi aca kuri ico kiraro.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Kubera ko uwo muduga «Black Beauty» uri hasi cane, igipolisi gishasha co muri Nouvelle Zélande nticashoboye gukoresha udukoresho twabo dupima umuvuduko kugira bamenye umuvuduko umushingantahe Reid yariko agirako. Cashoboye kubikora igihe gusa umushingantahe Reid yagabanya akagendera ku muvuduko w'ibilometero 160 kw'isaha.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Mu mezi 3 aheze, abantu barenga 80 bafashwe bararekuwe bava mu nyubakwa z'Ibiro bikuru vyakira abanyororo ata caha bagirijwe icese.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Muri Ndamukiza muri uwu mwaka, umucamanza Judge Glynn yarasohoye itegeko mfatakibanza risaba ivyo biro kurekura abamaze amasaha arenga 24 bafashwe batigeze bumvirizwa n'intumwa ya sentare.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Iyo ntumwa ya sentare ni yo ishinga ko uwafashwe yotanga ingwati n'igitigiri cayo ikongera ikakira icese ibirego vyanditswe n'inyamiramabi yahagaritse uwo muntu. Ivyo birego biraheza bikandikwa mu buhinga bw'inyabwonko bw'iyo leta kugira ngo bikurikiranwe.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Itariki uwagirijwe icaha yumvirijweko, aca aronka uburenganzira bwo kuburanishwa mu maguru masha.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, umushikiranganji ajejwe ikigega ca Leta muri Ositaraliya akaba ari na we vyiyumvirwa cane ko azoshobora gusubirira umushikiranganji wa mbere John Howard mu mabanga yo kurongora umugambwe w'aba Libéraux, yarashigikiye cane umugambi wo guhingura muri Ostaraliya amasoko ntanganguvu yitwa «nucléaire ».
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Umushingantahe Costello yavuze ko bimaze kubona ko hariho uburyo bukwiye bwo guhingura ayo masoko ntanganguvu ya «nucléaire», igihugu ca Ositaraliya gikwiye kubandanya kuyikorako.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Umushingantahe Costello yavuze ati: "Nimba vyokwinjiza amahera, dukwiye kubikora. Nshaka kuvuga ko ata kibi kirimwo mu gukoresha ayo masoko ntanganguvu ya nucléaire."
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Igihe abasangwa batangura gukwiragiza ivyari vyabashikiye, myinshi mu miryango vyega yateye ibona ko Carolyn Wilson wo muri OHA yari yamaze kwiba utwo baziganije, ahita ahunga aja hanze y´igisagara.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Abasangwa i Lockwood Gardens bizera ko hoba hariho iyindi miryango 40 canke irenga izoshikirwa n´ukwimurwa, kuko bamenye ko igipolisi ca OHA naco kiriko kiratohoza ku zindi nzu rusangi zo kubamwo muri Oakland zoba zoshirwamwo mu manyanga y´ivy´amazu.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Umugwi waburijemwo ikirori ku Kibuga citiriwe Kwibuka Intambara y´aba Maui, ico cari kwitabirwa n´abantu 9,000, kandi basaba imbabazi abakunzi.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Ishirahamwe ry´abashinzwe uwo mugwi, HK Management Inc., nta mvo zabiteye batanze aho baburizamwo ku wa 20 Nyakanga, ariko bataye ikosa ku mwo z´uburyo umunsi wakwirikiye.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Ivyamamare vy´abashingwamanza b´Abagiriki, Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos bamaze gufungirwa mw´ibohero ry´i Athenes rya Korydallus, kuko bari bamaze gusangwa bagirwa n´uguharanira inyungu zabo bwite n´ukurya ibiturire.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Bitewe n´ibi, ibara rikomeye mu rwego rw´ubutungane rw´abagiriki ryaragarutsweko mu gushira ahabona ibikorwa bidaciye mu mategeko abacamanza, abashingwamanza, ababuranira n´aba avoka bakoze mu myaka iheze.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Mu mayinga make aheze, inyuma y´amakuru yashizwe ahabona n´umumenyeshamakuru Makis Triantafylopoulos mu kiganiro ciwe co ku Mboneshakure gikunzwe cane "Zoungla" kuri Mboneshakure Alpha, umushingamateka akaba n´umushingwamanza, Petros Mantouvalos yaratanze imihoho kuko abakozi b´ibiro vyiwe bari begwa n´uguharanira inyungu zabo bwite n´ukurya ibiturire.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Inyenyeri zitanga umuco n'ubushuhe kubera inguvu zikozwe iyo atome za idrojene ziteranijwe (canke zishongesherejwe) hamwe kugira bikore ibintu biremereye gusumba.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Abashakashatsi bariko barahingura imashine ishobora gutanga inguvu cokimwe nizo nyenyeri.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ico, vyongeye, ningorane igoye cane gukemura kandi izosaba imyaka myinshi imbere yuko haboneka amamashine y'ihuza afise akamaro yubatswe.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Urushinge rwa asye rureremba kumazi kubera inguvu ziyariko.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Inguvu ziri kuriyo zikorwa kuberako amamolekire y'amazi ari kuburinganire bw'amazi akwegwa cane hagati yayo gusumba uko akwegwa n'ama molekile y'umuyaga hejuru yayo.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Amamolekire y'amazi akora urukoba rutaboneka kuburinganire bw'amazi bituma ibintu nkurushinge bireremba hejuru y'amazi.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Urubaho rwo kw'inyerezako k'urubura rugezweho rufise impande zibiri hamwe n'ikinogo gifukuye hagati yazo. Izo mpande zibiri zifasha gufata neza urubura, naho nzohengamikwa.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Kuberako indiba z'urubaho rwo kw'inyerezako ruzinzeko buke buke, mugihe urubaho rwo kw'inyerezako ruhengetse kuruhande rumwe canke urundi, uruhande ruriko urubura rurizinga nagwo.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Ibi bituma uwunyerera kurubura ahindukira. Mugihe udukoresho two kwinyereza twihindukije muburyo, uwunyerera kurubura azunguruka iburyo, iyo udukoresho two kwinyereza tugiye ibubamfu, uwunyerera kurubura aca azunguruka ibubamfu.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Kugira zigaruke kurugero rwazo rwinguvu, zitegerezwa kwikurako inguvu zirengako zari zakuye k'umuco.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Zibikora mukurungika uduhimba duto duto tw'umuco twitwa "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Abashakashatsi bataziriye urwo rukurikirane "irungikwa rikabuwe n'imishwarara" kubera ko uduhimba dutoduto tw'ikintu dukaburwa n'umuco wamuje, bigakwega irungikwa ry'ama photons y'umuco, kandi umuco nawo ni ubwoko bw'umushwarara.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ifoto ikurikira yerekana ama atome arekura ama photons. Nivyo cane, mukuri, ama photons ni mato cane ugereranije n'ayari kw'ifoto.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Ama photons ni na mato cane ugereranije n'uduhimba tugize ama atome!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Inyuma y'amasaha amajana itara ririko rirakora, akuma gato kari imbere mw'itara birangira gahiye hama itara rikareka gukora.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Itara rirategerezwa guhindurwa. Birasabwa kwitonda cane muguhindura itara.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Ubwambere, bishakirwa ko amatara aba azimije canke kable igacomorwa.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Ivyo ni kubera umuyagankuba utembera mw'isoke aho igice c'icuma ca ampure kija ushobora kugukubita iyo ukoze indani mw'i soke canke ku ntango ry'icuma co kuri ampure igihe igice kikiri mw' isoke.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Igihimba nyamukuru mw'itembera ry'amaraso ni umutima, wo urungika amaraso.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Amaraso ava mu mutima aciye mu miringoti yitwa artères, akagarukayo aciye mu turingoti twitwa veines, Uturingoti dutoyi gusumba twose twitwa capillaires.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Amenyo y'ivyo bikoko vyitwa tricératops, biboneka ko atashobora guhekenya gusa amababi mugabo ko yashobora no guhekenya amashami n'imizi bigumye.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Hari abahinga biyumvira ko ivyo bikoko vyitwa tricératops vyarya ibimera vyitwa cycades vyari bigwiriye mu kiringo citwa crétacé.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ivyo bimera womengo ni utugazi, bikaba vyikoreye igishurwe c'utubabibabi dushinze kandi dusongoye.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Igikoko tricératops gishobora kuba carakoresha urunwa rwaco rukomeye mu gukura amababi ku giti imbere yo kukirya.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Abandi bahinga bo bavuga ko ivyo bimera birimwo ubumara bwinshi ku buryo bisa n'uko ata dinozoro n'imwe yari kubirya, naho muri iki gihe igikoko citwa paresseux n'ibindi bikoko nka gasuku (yakomotse ku madinozoro) bishobora kurya amababi canke ivyamwa vy'ubumara.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ukwezi Io kwonkwega gute? Hamwe wohagarara ku kwezi Io, wopima ibilo biri munsi y'ivyo upima uri kw'isi.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Umuntu apima amapawundi 200 (ibilo 90) kw'isi yoca apima amapawundi nka 36 (ibilo 16) kuri Io. Rero ukwo kwezi ntikwogukwega cane nk'isi.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Izuba ntirifise ubutaka nk'ubw'isi wohagararako. Izuba ryose rigizwe n'imyuka, umuriro n'ivyitwa plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Uko uja kure y'intimatima y'izuba, ni ko umwuka ugenda uragabanuka.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Igice c'inyuma tubona igihe twitegereje izuba citwa photosphère, bisobanura ngo "imburungu y'umuco".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Inyuma y'imyaka nk'ibihumbi bitatu, mu 1610, umuhinga w'ivyo mu kirere w'Umutaliyano yitwa Galileo Galilei yarakoresheje itarubindi arabona yuko ishusho ya Venisi igenda irahinduka, cokimwe n'ukwezi.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Amahindagurika y'ishusho aba kubera ko igice ca Venisi (canke c'ukwezi) kirabana n'izuba ari co kimukirwa. Amahindagurika y'ishusho ya Venisi yaremeje imibumbe izunguruka izuba nk'uko Copernicus yari yaravyiyumviriye.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Maze haciye imyaka mike, mu 1639, umuhinga w'ivyo mu kirere w'Umwongereza yitwa Jeremiah Horrocks yaritegereje irengana rya Venisi.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Ubwongereza bwari bwamaze igihe kirekire mu mahoro inyuma yo guhabuza Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Mugabo mu 991 Ethelred yarahanganye n’amato y’Abavikingi asumba ayandi yose yabayeho inyuma y’aya Guthrum mu kinjana c’imbere yaho.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Ayo mato yari arongowe na Olaf Trygvasson, Umunyanoroveji yari afise intumbero yo guhabuza igihugu ciwe ngo kireke kuganzwa na Danemarike.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Inyuma yo gutsindwa mu ntambara za mbere, Ethelred yarashoboye kwumvikana na Olaf, uwo na we aca asubira muri Noroveji kugerageza guhabuza ingoma yiwe, rimwerimwe atsinda ikindi gihe na ho atsindwa.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Mu nkurikirane z'indome ziyumviriwe zigatunganywa, Hangeul ni rwo rwonyene rukoreshwa cane buri musi. Rwatunganijwe mu 1444 ku ntwaro y'Umwami Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Umwami Sejong yagira kane mu bami bo mu muryango w'aba Joseon kandi ni umwe mu bubahwa cane.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Mu ntango, urwo rukirikirane rw'indome yarwise Hunmin Jeongeum, bisobanura ngo "amajwi atomoye yo kwigisha abantu".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Hiyumvirwa vyinshi ku nkomoko y'ururimi rwa sanskrit. Hari abiyumvira ko rwatanguye igihe abantu bo mu bwoko bw'Abariyeni bava mu burengero bakimukira mu Buhindi, bajanayo ururimi rwabo.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ni ururimi rwa kera, rukaba rwogereranywa n'ikilatini cavugwa i Buraya.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Igitabu ca kera kuruta vyose kw'isi canditswe mu rurimi rwa sanskrit. Ibisomwa vyitwa oupanishad bimaze kwegeranywa, urwo rurimi rwaciye ruzimangana kubera abakuru.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ni ururimi ruhanitse kandi rutunze cane, rukaba rwarakomotseko indimi nyinshi zo mu Buhindi zo muri iki gihe, nk'uko n'ikilatini rwakomotseko indimi z'i Buraya nk'igifaransa n'iki-esupanyoli.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Urugamba rwo kwigarurira Ubufaransa rurangiye, Ubudagi bwaciye butangura kwitegurira gutera izinga ry'Ubwongereza.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Ubudagi bwise ico gitero “Opération Lion de mer”. Vyinshi mu birwanisho bikomeye n'ibintu vy'igisoda c'Ubwongereza vyari vyatakaye igihe cava i Dunkirk. Rero igisoda hari ukuntu cagoyagoya.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mugabo Igisoda co mu mazi c'Ubwongereza cari kigikomeye gusumba ic'Ubudagi (“Kriegsmarine”), kikaba carashobora gusambura amato yose y'umwansi agerageje kujabuka amazi yaho yitwa la Manche.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Yamara, amato makeyi cane y'ico Gisoda co mu mazi ni yo yari hafi y'aho ibitero vyashobora kuzanana, kuko abakuru b'igisoda co mu mazi batinya ko ayo mato agwa mu gitero c'indege z'Abadagi.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tubanze dusigure ivyo Ubutaliyano bwari bugamije. Ahanini bwari bumeze nka "mutoyi" w'Ubudagi n'Ubuyapani.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Igisoda cabwo co hasi n'ico mu mazi nticari gikomoye, naho bari baherutse kwubaka amato ane imbere y'uko intambara itangura.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Ubutaliyano bwari bugamije ahanini ibihugu vyo muri Afrika. Kugira bubifate, bokeneye kuba bafise ahantu inteko zitera zivuye, kugira zijabuke Ikiyaga Mediterane maze zitere Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Bari bakeneye rero gukuraho ibirindiro vy'Abongereza n'amato yabwo vyari mu Misiri. Ivyo gusa ni vyo amato y'intambara y'Ubutaliyano yasabwa gukora.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Nayo Ubuyapani, igihugu cabwo cari kigizwe n'izinga cokimwe n'Ubwongereza.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Sous-marins ni amato yakorewe guca munsi y'amazi, akagumayo igihe kirekire.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Amato aca munsi y'amazi yarakoreshejwe mu Ntambara ya mbere y'isi yose no mu ya kabiri. Ico gihe, yagenda bukebuke cane kandi ntiyarasa kure rwose.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Mu ntango z'iyo ntambara, ayo mato yagendera ahanini hejuru y'amazi, mugabo aho ubuhinga bwitwa radar butanguriye gutunganwa no kuryohorwa, ayo mato yaciye abwirizwa kuza arandera munsi y'amazi kugira ntabonwe.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Amato y'Abadagi agendera munsi y'amazi yiswe U-Boats. Abadagi bari bazi rwose kunyonga no gukoresha ayo mato yabo.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Kubera ko bazi cane ivy'amato agendera munsi y'amazi, inyuma y'intambara Abadagi ntibacizerwa cane kubona bafise mwene ayo mato menshi.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ego cane! Umwami Tutanikamoni, uwuhora yitwa rimwe na rimwe yitwa "Umwami Tut" canke "Umwami akiri umwana", ni umwe mu bami ba kera bo mu Misiri bazwi cane mu bihe vya none.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Igitangaje, kera ntiyabonwa ko ahambaye cane kandi ku ntonde nyinshi z'abami ba kera ntiyanditswemwo.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ariko aho imva yiwe yuburiwe mu 1922, yaciye amenyekana cane. Izindi mva nynshi za kera zarasahuwe, mugabo iyiwe nta kintu kinini yabaye.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Vyinshi mu bintu Toutankamon yahambanywe vyarazigamwe neza, harimwo n'utugenegene ibihumbi dukozwe mu butare bw'agaciro n'amabuye y'imbonekarimwe.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Igihe amapine afise ibimeze nk'amasera yatanguzwa, vyatumye imikogote y'Abashuri ihwahuka, inyaruka cane, ku buryo ishobora gusiga abandi basoda n'iyindi mikogote.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Imyampi barasisha imiheto yica imeze bukoho yarashobora kumena ibirwanisho vy'umusoda w'umwansi. Nko mu 1000 Imbere ya Kristu, Abashuri baratanguye gukoresha igisoda c'amafarasi.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Igisoda c'amafarasi kiba kigizwe n'abarwanira ku mafarasi. Kubera ko ivyo basasa ku mafarasi bitari bwabeho, abo basoda b'Abashuri barwana bicaye gusa ku migongo y'amafarasi yabo.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Turazi Abagiriki benshi b'abanyapolitike, b'abahinga n'abahinga mu vy'utugenegene. Umwe muri bo azwi kuruta abandi ashobora kuba ari Homère, wa mwanditsi w'ivyese azwi cane w'impumyi yatunganije ivyese bibiri bikomeye cane mu vyanditswe n'Abagiriki: icese citwa Iliade n'icitwa Odyssée.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocle na Aristophane baracari abanditsi b'ibikino bemerwa cane kandi ibikino banditse biri mu gitigiri c'ivyandikano vyemerwa kuruta ibindi vyose kw'isi.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Uwundi Mugiriki rurangiranwa ni wa muhinga mu biharuro Pythagore, azwi canecane kubera iciyumviro yashitseko kijanye n'amasano ari hagati y'impande z'inyabutatu y'imfuruka ngororotsi.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Hari ibitigiri ngereranyo bitandukanye bitangwa vy'abavuga igihindi uko bangana. Vyiyumvirwa ko rwoba ari ururimi rugira kabiri, gatatu canke kane ruvugwa cane kw'isi.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Igitigiri c'imvukira ziruvuga kivana n'uko umuntu yoba aharuye n'abavuga indimirimi bifitaniye isano cane.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Ibiharuro ngereranyo bivuga ko ruvugwa n'abari hagati y'imiliyoni 340 na 500 kandi ko abashika imiliyoni 800 barutahura.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Igihindi n'urwitwa Urdu bifise amajambo aja gusa mugabo indome ziratandukanye. Mu biyago vya misi yose, abavuga izo ndimi zibiri usanga kenshi bumvikana.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Amaja mu kinjana ca 15, akarere ko mu buraruko bwa Esitoniya kisunga cane imico y'Abadagi.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Abafurera bamwebamwe b'Abadagi baratanguje inyandiko y'ikinya-esitoniya kugira bafashe imvukira zaho kurushiriza kumenya Imana.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Bakoresheje indome z'ikidagi, bongerako urudome "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Uko igihe cahaciye, amajambo menshi yatiwe mu kidagi yaranywanye n'urwo rurimi. Umuco wari ugiye waboneka.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Mu bisanzwe samuragwa w'ubwami yaca ubwo nyene aja mu gisoda akirangiza amashure.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Ariko Karoli we yaciye aja kuri kaminuza yitwa Trinity College, i Cambridge, aho yize ivyerekeye imico n'imigenzo y'abantu hamwe n'ibijanye n'ibisigira vya kera, mu nyuma yiga ivya kahise, aronka urupapuro rwitwa 2:2 (ruhabwa abaronse kw'ijana).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Karoli yabaye uwa mbere mu bo mu nda y'ingoma y'Ubwongereza yaronse urupapuro rw'umutsindo.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Tirikiya y'i Buraya (ubuseruko bwa Thrace canke Roumélie mu karere kitwa les Balkans) igize ibice 3 kw'ijana vy'ico gihugu.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Akarere ka Tirikiya gafise uburebure bw'ibilometero birenga 1.600 (mayiri 1.000) n'ubwaguke bw'ibilometero 800 (mayiri 500), kakaba kagomba kumera nk'urukiramende.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Akarere ka Tirikiya, ushizemwo n'ibiyaga, kangana n'ibilometero kwadarato 783.562 (mayiri kwadarato 300.948), ibilometero kwadarato 755.688 (mayiri kwadarato 291.773) muri vyo bikaba biri mu bumanuko bushira ubumanuko bwa Aziya, ibilometero kwadarato 23.764 (mayiri kwadarato 9.174) na vyo bikaba i Buraya.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Uravye ingene Tirikiya ingana, ni co gihugu kigira 37 kw'isi mu bunini, kikaba kigomba kungana n'akarere nyamukuru k'Ubufaransa n'aka Royaume-Uni ubifatiye hamwe.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Tirikiya ikikujwe n'ibiyaga impande zitatu: Ikiyaga Égée mu burengero, Ikiyaga c'Umunyu mu buraruko, n'Ikiyaga Mediterane mu bumanuko.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg ifise kahise karere mugabo yikukiye mu 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Hari ibice vy'Ububiligi vyahora vyegukira Luxembourg. Vyegukiye Ububiligi inyuma y'Imigumuko yo mu Bubiligi yabaye mu 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Igihugu ca Luxembourg camye kigerageza kwirinda guhengama mu vya politike mugabo carigaruriwe n'Ubudagi mu Ntambara ya mbere y'isi yose n'iya kabiri.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mu 1957, Luxembourg yabaye kimwe mu bihugu vyatanguje ishirahamwe ubu ryitwa Ishirahamwe ry'Abanyaburaya.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ni inyubakwa ishaje yahoze ikomeye ikaba n'ikigo c'abihebeyimana b'Ababuda iri mu gice co haruguru c'intara ya Paro (mu kigwati ca Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Bivugwa ko mu 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel yubakishije iyo nyubakwa ikomeye ngo ibe icibutso c'ingene yatsinze ingabo z'Abanyatibe n'Abamongoli.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Mu 1951, umuriro waradutse utuma hasigara gusa ibisigarira bikeyi vy'iyo nyubakwa ya Drukgyal Dzong, nk'igishusho ca Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Inyuma y'uwo muriro, iyo nyubakwa yarazigamwe irakingirwa, isigara ari kimwe mu bintu vy'i Bhutan bikwega cane ingezi.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Mu kinjana ca 18, igihugu ca Kamboje cugaraniwe hagati y'ibihugu bibanyi bibiri bikomeye: Tayilande na Viyetinamu.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Abanyatayilande barateye Kamboje incuro nka zingahe mu kinjana ca 18, mu 1772 basambura Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mu myaka ya nyuma yo mu kinjana ca 18, Abanyaviyetinamu na bo nyene barateye Kamboje.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ibice cumi n'umunani kw'ijana vy'Abanyavenezuwela nta kazi bagira, kandi benshi mu bafise akazi bikorera utwabo.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Bibiri vya bitatu vy'Abanyavenezuwela bafise akazi usanga bakorera abandi amaserevisi, hafi ica kane bagakorera mu mahinguriro, ica gatanu bagakora ivy'uburimyi.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Ihinguriro ry'igitoro rirahambaye cane muri Venezuwela. Kirashora hanze igitoro cinshi naho igice kimwe kw'ijana gusa ari bo bakorera mu vy'igitoro.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Mu ntango z'ukwikukira kwa Singapuru, ubuhinga bwakoreshejwe muri ubwo busitani bwitwa Singapore Botanic Gardens bwarafashije guhindura iryo zinga, risigara rimeze nk'igisagara c'ubusitani co mu karere gashushe.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mu 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, ishurwe ry'uruvange ryo mu bwoko bwa orchidée, ryaratowe ngo ribe ikimenyetso c'igihugu.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Buri mwaka nko muri Gitugutu, ibikoko hafi umuliyoni 1,5 birisha birajabuka uruzi Mara bikaja mu biyaya vyo mu bumanuko bivuye mu mirambi yo mu buraruko, bigiye kurondera imvura.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Biraheza bikagaruka mu buraruko biciye mu buseruko, bigasubira kujabuka uruzi Mara, inyuma y'imvura y'amaja muri Ndamukiza.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Intara ya Serengeti irimwo Pariki y'igihugu ya Serengeti, ahitwa Ngorongoro Conservation Area, ahitwa Maswa Game Reserve muri Tanzaniya be n'ahitwa Maasai Mara National Reserve muri Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kumenya gutunganya ibikoresho ntangamakuru bikorana na nyene kubikoresha bisaba ubuhinga busanzwe n'ubundi buhinga umuntu yigishwa gukoresha neza (gushushanya, gutunganya neza amajwi n'amasanamu, kwigana inkuru, n'ibindi.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Gutunganya ibikoresho ntangamakuru bikorana n'ababikoresha bisaba gusuzuma ivyiyumviro usanganywe ku bijanye n'ingene ibikoresho ntangamakuru bitunganywa, ukiga kwiyumvira mu bundi butazitiye.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Gutunganya mwene ivyo bikoresho bisaba ko ibihimba bigize ico kintu bihuza, ariko kimwekimwe ukwaco kikaba cikwije.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Ingorane y'imbone igagamishwa y'icuma gifotora ni uko kugira ushobore gukwega neza ishusho ku ngero zitandukanye, bisaba ubuhinga burebure bw'imbone n'igitigiri kanaka cazo. Ku mbone zitagagamishwa biroroshe gusumba.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Ariko ico kibazo kiriko kirakemurwa kuko haguma hahingurwa imbone z'ivyuma bifotora zihanitse gusumba.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Ivyo bituma imbone zigagamishwa zishobora gusohora amafoto meza nk'ayaboneka iyo hakoreshejwe imbone zitagagamishwa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Iyindi ngorane y'imbone zigagamishwa ni uko ukwuguruka kwazo kwuzuye (ubunyarutsi) gukunze kuba guto.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Ivyo bituma imbone zigagamishwa zizimbutse zigorana gukoresha ahari umuco muke udafise flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Imwe mu ngorane zikunda gushika iyo uriko uragerageza guhindura ireresi ngo ije mu mero ya DVD ni ovasikane.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Imboneshakure nyinshi zikozwe kugira zinezereze abantu muri rusangi.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ku bw’iyo mvo, ku mpera y'amasanamu yose ubona ku mboneshakure harakaswe, hejuru, hasi, no ku mpande.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Ibi bikorwa kugira ngo isanamu ikwire ekara yose. Ibi vyitwa ovasikane.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ikibabaje, iyo ukoze DVD, impera zayo kenshi ziba zikase na zo nyene, kandi igihe iyo reresi ifise amajambo yanditswemwo ayisigura yegereye cane hasi, ntaba akibonetse yose.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Abantu bamye biyumvira vyinshi ku nzu nini za kera z’ibihome bikomeye zubatswe hagati y'ikinjana ca gatanu n'impera z'ikinjana ca cumi na gatanu, bakabona mu bwenge amahiganwa yaba yo kugwanira ku mafarasi, imfungurwa basangirira hamwe ari benshi, hamwe n'igisoda c'intwari ca Arthur.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Naho woba uhagaze gusa mu bisigarira bimaze imyaka igihumbi, biroroshe kwiha ishusho y’intambara zabaye kera, ukumva imigere y’amafarasi n’ubwoba bw’abafungiwe mu busho buhishije cane.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ariko burya vyoba vyari nk'uko tuvyiyumvira? Ni kuki inzu nini z’ibihome bikomeye zubatswe? Imigero yazo yari imeze gute, kandi zubakwa gute?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Cokimwe n'izindi shato z'ico gihe, Shato y'i Kirby Muxloe si shato nyayo ahubwo isa cane n'inyubakwa ikingijwe ibikuta.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Amadirisha yayo akayangana n'impome zayo zonze ntivyari kurinda ibitero bikaze ikiringo kirekire.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Igihe Umutware Hastings yarangura kuyubaka mu myaka ya 1480, igihugu cari gifise amahoro ku rugero runaka, kandi bakenera gusa kwivuna utugwi tw'abasuma twigenza.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ukurimbanya ubutegetsi bwari uburyo ibihugu vy'i Buraya bwakoresheje kugira kimwe cose muri vyo kigumane ubwigenge bwaco.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Iciyumviro cari ic'uko ibihugu vyose vy'i Buraya vyategerezwa kubuza igihugu kimwe gukomera birenze. Ni co gituma intwaro zaho zakunda guhindura inani zagiranye kugira ntihabe ubusumbane.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Intambara yiswe guerre de Succession d'Espagne yabaye intambara ya mbere ijanye n'ico kibazo co kurimbanya ubutegetsi.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Ryari ihinduka rikomeye kubera ko ico gihe ibihugu bikomeye vy'i Buraya bitosubiye kurwana vyitwaje idini. Ya Ntambara y'imyaka mirongo itatu yobaye yo ntambara ya nyuma yitirirwa idini.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Urusengero rwa Artemis rw'i Efeso rwasambutse ku wa 21 Mukakaro 356 M.K. ruturiwe nkana na Érostrate.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Bivugwa ko yarondera kumenyekana vyanka vyakunda. Abanyefeso bararatse, baca batangaza ko izina rya Érostrate ridakwiye kwigera ryandikwa.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Strabon, umuhinga mu vya kahise w'Umugiriki, yahavuye yandika iryo zina, ari co gituma turizi uyu musi. Urwo rusengero rwaturiwe ijoro nyene Alegizandere Mukuru yavuka.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alegizandere amaze kuba umwami yaripfuje gusanura urwo rusengero, baramwankira. Rwahavuye rusanurwa mu 323 M.K. amaze gupfa.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Raba neza ko intoke zahwe zorohewe igihe ufyonda ayo manota yose, kandi ugerageze kudakoresha cane intoke zawe ibidakenewe.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Gutyo ntuzoruha cane. Wibuke ko bidakenewe yuko ufyonda amanota n'inguvu kugira avuge cane nka kurya bigenda kuri piyano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Kugira inota rivuge cane ku kinanda, ukoresha igisaho caco n'inguvu canke unyarutsa.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Ukunywana n'Imana ni ukugerageza kwiyeregeza ikibirengeye, ikimana, ukuri kw'ivy'impwemu canke Imana, kuyiyumvamwo canke kuyitahura.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Uwemera aba arondera ukubibabamwo, ugutahura, canke ubumenyi mu kuri ku bijanye n´Imana/ ikigirwamana canke ibigirwamana.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Abayoboke bakwirikirana inzira zizwi zo kubaho, canke imigenzo igenewe gukomeza ivyo babayemwo.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Ukwemera ibisigabwenge bishobora gutandukanwa n´ukundi kwemera kw´amadini canke ugusenga biciye ku kuntu kwibanda mu vyo umuntu yabayemwo mu gihe yaba mu bihe bitangaje, na cane cane ku bantu b´abanyamahoro, bafise ubumenyi bwinshi, babayeho banezerewe, canke bafise kamere yo kunezerwa cane.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhisme n'idini ryo m'Ubuhindi bwo mu bumanuko. Ryakomotse mu karere ka Punjab mu kinjana ca 15 bitewe n'ukwiyonkora kw'imihari kwo mu migenzo y'Aba Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Aba Sikhs bafata nk'aho ukwemera kwabo ari idini ritandukanye n'irya Hinduisme n'aho babizi neza ko gufise imizi n'imigenzo ya gi Hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Aba Sikhs bita ishengero ryabo Gurmat, n'igi Punjab gisigura ngo "inzira y'umwigisha mukuru". Umwigisha mukuru ni ngombwa bidasanzwe mu madini yose y'Abahindi ariko muri Sikhisme agira akamaro kagena imizi y'ukwemera kw'aba Sikhs.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Iryo dini ryatangujwe mu kinjana ca 15 n'umwigisha mukuru Nanak (1469-1539). Hakwirikiye abigisha bakuru icenda bagiye bakurakuranwa.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: N'aho biri ukwo, muri Ruheshi 1956, ivyo Krushchev yiyemeje vyarapimwe aho imigumuko muri Pologne, aho abakozi bariko biyamiriza ubukene bw'imfungurwa n'ukugabanuka kw'imishahara, bahindukira bakiyamiririza hamwe Communisme.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ariko mu mpera, Krushchev yarungitse amaburende kugira agarukane umutekano, yaremeye bimwe mu vyo basaba ku mafaranga kandi yemera kugena uwushigikiwe cane Wladyslaw Gomulka nk'icegera cambere.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ibisagara vyo mu kabande ka Indus Valley vyari ibisagara vyo mu bihe vya Bronze mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwo m'Ubuhindi bwa ruguru harimwo Pakistani y'ubu n'uturere tumwe tumwe mu buraruko bushira uburengero bw'Ubuhindi no mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Afuganistani.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ico gisagara vyaratagase mu biyaya vy'uruzi Indus ari naho gikura izina ryaco.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: N'aho abanyeshure bamwe bahitishamwo ngo kuva ico gisagara carabayeho no mu biyaya vy'uruzi rusigaye rwarakamye rwa Sarasvati, cabwirizwa kwitwa neza na neza igisagara ca Indus-Sarasvati, mu gihe bamwe bacita igisagara ca Harappan bisunze Harappa, kimwe mu bibanza vyaho vyambere vyatanguye gucukurwa mu za 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Kamere ya Gisirikare y'ubwami bw'aba Romani karafashije mw'iterambere ry'ukuduga kw'ubuganga.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Abaganga batanguye guhabwa akazi n'Umwami w'abami Augustus maze banashiraho umugwi wambere w'Abaganga b'Abaromani bo kuvura abantu inyuma y'intambara.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Abaganga babaga bari bafise ubumenyi bw'ibisinziriza vyinshi harimwo na morphine ikorwa mu ntete ziturika na scopolamine iva mu ntete z'ivyatsi.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Baranonosoye ugukata ibihimba kugira bakingire abagwayi ibora ry'ibisebe hamwe n'ivy'ibikoresho bizibira imitsi bikabuza amaraso kuva.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Mu gihe c'ibinjana vyinshi, ubwami bw'Abaromani bwatumye haba inyungu nyinshin mu bijanye n'ubuganga kandi habaho ubumenyi dufise uyu musi.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami ya Pureland ni origami ifise inzitizi ku buryo ushobora kuzinga rimwe gusa ku mwanya umwe, kuzinga kenshi nko kuzinga usubiza inyuma ntibikunda, kandi aho bazingira hose hafise impande zigenda imbere.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Yahinguwe na John Smith muri za 1970s kugira ifashe abadafise ubumenyi mu kuzinga canke abo bafise intambamyi mu bushobozi bw'imitsi.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Abana biga kubona ubwoko n'itandukaniro rifatiye ku moko bakiri bato kandi iryo tandukanya rifatiye ku moko ritagira ingaruko ku kuntu bitwara.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Nk'akarorero, abana bibona ko ari abo mu bwoko bw'inkehwa bubonwa nk'aho budakora neza kw'ishure bahakwa kudakora neza mw'ishure mu gihe bamaze kumenya ukwo kuntu bavugwa mu bwoko bwabo.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ni urubuga rugira gatatu mu mbuga ngurukanabumenyi zikundwa n’abantu benshi zikoreshwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kandi ruriko imyidondoro y'abantu imiriyoni 54 muri kano kanya.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Izi mbuga ngurukanabumenyi zirakurikirwa cane, na canecane mu gisata c’indero.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Hariho ibintu vyiza biranga izo mbuga ngurukanabumenyi, harimwo gushobora gushiraho vyoroshe urubuga rw'ishure rushobora kubamwo ama blog, amareresi, amasanamu, hamwe n’ibindi bintu.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Uru rubuga rurashobora gushikwako vyoroshe mu gutanga inzira y'umuhora ngurukanabumenyi imwe gusa, bigatuma woroha kwibuka no kwandika ku banyeshure bashobora kuba bafise ingorane yo gukoresha icandikisho c’inyabwonko canke yo gutondeka neza indome zigize ijambo.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Urashobora kuruhinyanyura kugira vyorohe gusoma ibiriko, ugashiramwo amabara menshi canke make nk'uko uvyipfuza.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Ingwara yo Gusamara Cane "ni ingwara yo mu bwenge ifise inyabutatu y'ibimenyetso biyiranga birimwo uguhubuka, ugutwarwa n'ukutaguma hamwe canke ukugira umwete urengeje".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Si ubumuga mu bijanye no kwiga, ni ingorane mu vyo kwiga; "ishikira 3 canke 5 kw'ijana mu bana bose, kumbure abashika nk'imiliyoni 2 z'abana b'Abanyamerika".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Abana bafise ingorane ya ADD bafise ibibazo vyo kugumiza umutima ku bintu nk'ibikorwa vy'ishure, ariko bashobora kugumiza umutima ku bintu baryohererwa gukora nko gukina inkino canke kuraba desanime canke kwandika amajambo ata dukwabu.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Abo bana bameze nk'abama mu bibazo vyinshi, kuko "baja mu bintu birimwo ingorane, bararwana, kandi ntibatinye ababakurira" kugira bakabure ubwonko bwabo, kuko ubwonko bwabo budashobora gukaburwa n'uburyo busanzwe.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Ingorane ya ADD iragira ingaruka ku migenderanire n'urundi runganwe kuko abandi bana ntibashobora gutahura igituma bigenza nk'ukwo canke igituma bandika ukwo canke bakavuga ngo urugero rwo guca akenge rwabo ruratandukanye.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Atari nk'izindi nkende, abantu ntibagikoresha amaboko yabo mu kugenda canke guterura ibiro vyabo canke mu kwenena mu biti.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Ukuboko kw'inguge n'ikirenge cayo birasa mu bunini no mu bwaguke, bikerekana igikorwa c'ukwo kuboko co kurerura uburemere bwayo no mu guhonyora ku nkoshi z'intoki.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Ukuboko kw'umuntu ni kugufi kuruta ikirenge, n'amagufa yo mu kiganza agoroye.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Ibi biraruhisha cane nk'aho woba uriko uravyuka buri minota mirongo ibiri canke mirongo itatu ukaraba imboneshakure.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Kubwa Bohr, ibi ni n’ibintu bigoye cane bigizwe n’ingobane canke selile yo hagati ikikijwe n’ivyitwa elekitro. Bimeze nk’imibumbe izunguruka iruhande y’izuba - raba isanamu ya 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Iyo ngobane yitwa nucleus igizwe n’uduce tubiri: akitwa netro nakitwa proto.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Izo proto zifise umuyagankuba mwiza ariko netro ntawo zifise. Elekitro zifise umuyagankuba mubi.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Gusa ingaruka ziterwa no kwumva wihebuye, atari izakabonge canke ubwoba, zishingiye ku nyigisho zisanzwe zijanye nivyo kugorora umubiri ziba buri ndwi.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Ukubona, canke ubushasha bwo kubona buva kubihimba bijejwe kuraba canke ku maso.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Hariho ibintu vyinshi bitandukanye bigize amaso, ivyo navyo bivana bigenda bigorana bivanye nico umubiri usaba.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Inyubako z'ijisho zifise ubushobozi butandukanye, ntizifise ububasha bumwe bwo kubona ibiri kure, kandi zisabwa ububasha butari buto kugira ngo zibone neza.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Iyo ibinyabuzima bigize umurwi vyose bisa, na cane cane uravye imforo yavyo, baca bavyita foroma imwe.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Iyo ivyo binyabuzima bifise inforo itandukanye bavyita Mudasa.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ibinyegeri vyose ntibigendana canke ngo biryame hamwe.

text: iyo buriko burimuka, ubunyegeri bugenda mwijoro hanyuma bukaryama ku murango.

text: Selile ni iki? Ijambo selile rikomoka mw’ijambo ry'ikilatini "cella"", risigura ""akumba gato", kandi iryo jambo ryatanguwe gukoreshwa n’umuhinga yariko yiga ibice bigize igiti coroshe kivamwo imifundikizo y’amacupa cane cane y'imivinyu.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Selile niyo tanguriro ry'ibinyabuzima vyose kandi imibiri yose irafise selile imwe canke nyinshi.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Selile nizo rufatiro mubijanye no kwiga ubuzima kandi ninaco gituma bazita "ibice vyubaka ubuzima".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Ubwonko nibwo butuma umuntu aguma abaho, mu kurungika ububasha mu mubiri wose, ivyo navyo bigatua amaraso aguma atembere atakiyabujije.

text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Igihe n’ikintu kidukikije, kandi kigira ingaruka muvyo dukora vyose, arikokigoye gutahura.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Igihe carizwe cane n’abagize amadini, filozofiya, n’ubumenyi haheze imyaka ibihumbi.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Twibaho igihe nk’urukurikirane rw'ibintu biva muri kazoza bikaja muri kahise biciye kuri kubu.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Igihe kandi ni uburyo tugereranya umwanya(umwanya wose) w’ivyabaye.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Urashobora gushiraho wewe nyene igihe caheze ukoresheje kuraba ibintu vyabaye vyisubiriza. Ibintu vyisubiriza ni ibintu biba kandi bigasubira bikaba keshi.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Mudasobwa uyumunsi zikoreshwa mu gukora amashusho n’amasanamu agenda.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animasiyo ihanitse irashobora kwubakwa kuri mudasobwa, kandi ubu bwoko bwa animasiyo bugenda bukoreshwa cane mu mboneshakure no mumareresi.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Umuziki ukunze gukorwa hakoreshejwe mudasobwa zihanitse mu gutunganya no kuvanga amajwi.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Mu kinjana ca cumi n'icenda n'ica mirongibiri, abantu barameze igihe kirekire biyumvira ko abatanguye kuba muri Nouvelle Zélande bari Abamawori, bahiga ibinyoni amahero vyitwa "moa".
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Ivyo vyiyumviro vyaciye vyemeza yuko Abamawori bavuye muri Polineziya bari mu bwato bunini, bomora Abamoriyori baba i Nouvelle Zélande barahigarurira, batangura kurima.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Ariko ibimenyamenya bishasha vyerekana ko Abamoriyori bari Abamawori bavuye mu karere nyamukuru ka Nouvelle Zélande baja kuba mu mazinga Chatham, barahava bagira imico bisangije y'abanyamahoro.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Hariho uwundi mugwi w'abantu mu mazinga Chatham, bakaba bari Abamawori bahaje bavuye muri Nouvelle Zélande.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Biyise Abamoriyori. Harabaye imishamirano mikeyi, amaherezo Abamoriyori barazimangana.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Abantu bari babigizemwo uruhara mu kiringo c'imyaka mirongo baradufashije kubona ubushobozi bwacu n'ishaka ryacu, barasuzuma n'ibitugora be n'ivyatunaniye, ata kurya umunwa.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Igihe twumviriza abantu batwiganiye ivyo babonye ku giti cabo, mu muryango no mu mashirahamwe, vyaradufashije cane gutahura kahise n'abantu bamwebamwe bagize akosho keza canke kabi ku karanga k'ishirahamwe.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Naho gutahura kahise bitama bisigura ko utahura akaranga, birafasha abantu n'imiburiburi gutahura ikibanza cabo muri kahise k'ishirahamwe.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Igihe bihweza ivyo bakoze neza bagatahura n'ivyo batakoze neza, umwe wese hamwe n'abandi bose bagize uruhara bararushiriza gutegera neza akarangamutima, intumbero n'inguvu vy'ishirahamwe.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Ico gihe, kwibuka ingene imbere y'aho berekanye ishaka mu vyo gutunganya imigambi hamwe n'ivyiza vyavuyemwo, vyatumye abantu bitegurira kwakira amahinduka n'uburongozi bushasha ku bw'ishengero ryaho.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Ivyo vyakunze muri kahise vyaragabanije ubwoba bw'amahinduka, bituma kandi bitegurira kwakira amahinduka azoza.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Guhuriza hamwe ivyiyumviro ni ubuhinga bwo gutorera inyishu ikibazo bushira hamwe ivyiyumviro canke ibisata bitandukanye kugira butore inyishu.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
