text: Ishimikiro ry’ubwo buhinga ni ukubanguka, ukwiyumvira mu buryo butumbereye n’ukutihenda, hamwe n’ukumenya ibintu ntaharirizwa, ugukoresha ubuhinga busanzwe buhari n'ugutororokanya amakuru.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Ikintu nyamukuru muri ubwo buryo bwo kubona ibintu ni uko hari inyishu imwe gusa y'ukuri. Wiyumvira inyishu zibiri gusa: ni co canke si co.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Ubu buryo bw’ukwiyumvira bufitaniye isano n’ubuhinga bumwebumwe canke n’uburyo ibintu bikunda gukorwamwo.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Abantu biyumvira muri buno buryo usanga biyumvira mu buryo butumbereye, bagafata ku mutwe uburyo ibintu bitunganijwe, bagatorera inyishu ingorane, bagakora n'ubushakashatsi mu vy’ubuhinga.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Abantu ni vyo biremwa vya mbere bizi gutahura ibiri mu bwenge bw'ibindi.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Ivyo bisigura ko dushobora kwiyumvira neza imbere y'igihe ivyo abandi bantu babona, bagamije, bemera, bazi canke bipfuza.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Muri ubwo bushobozi, ubwo gutahura ivyo abandi bagamije burahambaye cane. Buradufasha gutahura ivyo umuntu akoze vyoshobora gutahurwa nabi.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Nk'ubu ubonye umuntu ariko aramena ikiyo c'umuduga, woca wibwira ko ashaka kwiba umuduga w'abandi.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Ntitwomubona nabi hamwe yoba ari uwataye imfunguruzo z'umuduga wiwe, akaba ariko agerageza kumena ngo yinjire mu muduga wiwe.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: IRM ikoresha ubuhinga bwitwa "résonance magnétique nucléaire" (RMN) bwubuwe mu myaka ya 1930 na Felix Bloch (wo kuri Kaminuza ya Stanford) na Edward Purcell (wo kuri Kaminuza ya Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Muri ubwo buhinga bwa "résonance", ivyo bita "champ magnétique" na "ondes radio" biratuma atome zirekura udushwarara inzatsa twitwa "signaux radio".
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Mu 1970, Raymond Damadian, umuganga akaba n'umuhinga w'umushakashatsi, yarubuye ivyotuma ubuhinga bwa "résonance magnétique" bukoreshwa mu gupima indwara.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Haciye imyaka ine, yarahawe uburenganzira bwo kwitirirwa ubwo buhinga. Ni bwo bwa mbere bwatanzwe kw'isi yose mu bijanye na IRM.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mu 1977, Dogoteri Damadian yararangije kwubaka sikaneri ya mbere ya IRM “y'umubiri-wose”, ayita ”Mutananirwa”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Guhana amakuru n'umunyeshure ukwiwe bituma aronka umwanya wo kwiyumvira no kugira ico ashikirije abandi.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Bituma abanyeshure bashobora gukora ibintu ku muvuduko wabo, bakiga amakuru ku muvuduko bipfuza.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Vyongeye, habaye intambamyi nke z'umwanya igihe uba ushobora guhindura amasaha. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Internet n'imbuga ngurukanabumenyi bituma abiga bashobora kuronka amakuru umwanya wose.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Abanyeshure barashobora no kubaza ibibazo abigisha aho bashakiye, bakitega kudateba cane kuronka inyishu, aho kurindira ko basubira kubonana n'abigisha amaso mu yandi.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Kwiga muri ubwo buryo bwitwa "post-modernisme" bituma yikuramwo ivyitwa ko ari ntabanduka. Nta buryo bumwe gusa bwo kwiga bubaho.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Mbere ikintu ciza co kwiga si kimwe gusa. Kwiga biba igihe uwiga ari imbere y'ubumenyi ashikiriijwe.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Ivyo turabibona dufatiye ku vyo tumenyereye ubu mu bijanye no kwitunganiriza ibintu hamwe n'ibiganiro vyo ku mboneshakure biduha amakuru, bikaducisha ubwenge.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Benshi muri twebwe birahika tukarorera ikiganiro co ku mboneshakure kitumenyesha ubuhinga kanaka canke ikintu cabaye tutazopfa tugizemwo uruhara canke ngo dukoreshemwo ubwo bumenyi.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Ntituzopfa dusambuye umuduga wacu wose ngo tuwukore, canke ngo twubake isoko ry'amazi mu kigo, ngo tuje muri Peru kwihweza ibisigarira vya kera canke ngo dusubiremwo inzu y'umubanyi.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Groenland, biciye ku ntsinga za "fibre optiques" zica mu mazi zikahahuza n'Uburaya hamwe n'ubuhinga bwa satelite, iraronka neza internet, ibice 93 kw'ijana vy'abaho bakaba bayikoresha.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Ihoteli urimwo canke aho watse indaro (kaba ari agahoteli canke umuhana w'umuntu) ushobora gusanga hari wifi canke inyabwonko ifise internet, kandi ibigwati vyose usanga bifise siberi canke ahandi hantu hari wifi rusangi.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Nk'uko twari twabivuze, naho ijambo "Eskimo" ricemewe muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, benshi mu batari Abanyamerika baba mu karere kegereye isonga rya ruguru ry'isi, canecane muri Kanada, babona ko riryotazanya.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Naho ushobora kwumva iryo jambo rikoreshejwe n’imvukira za Gorowerande, abanyamahanga bakwiye kwirinda kurikoresha.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Abenegihugu kavukire ba Gorowerande biyita Inuit muri Kanada na Kalaalleq (mu bwinshi Kalaallit), canke umunyagoronerande muri Gorowerande.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Ubwicanyi no kudacungerwa bihagije ku banyamahanga muri rusangi ntibizwi gukorwa muri Greenland. Nubwo mubisagara, hatari "ibibanza bigoye."
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Ikirere gikanye nico kibazo kibi c'ukuri gikomeye abatiteguye bashobora guhura.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Iyo mutemberereye i Greenland mubihe vy' ubukonje (ariko iyo uduze m' uburaruko, niko hakanya), ni vyiza kwitwaza impuzu zishusha bikwiye.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Imisi miremire cane y' ici irashobora gutuma haba ibibazo vy'ukuronka itiro rikwiye birikumwe n' ingorane z' ubuzima.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Mugihe c' ici, mwiyubare kandi imibu yo m'uburaruko. Nubwo atangwara nimwe itera, irashobora kubasasata.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Mugihe ubutunzi bwa San Francisco bufatanye n'ukuba ikibanza mpuzamakungu c'iratiro, ubutunzi bwayo buratandukanye.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Igice k'inini c'ibisata bitanga akazi ni ibikorwa vy'abanyamyuga, intwaro, ubutunzi, ubudandaji, n'ingenzi.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Iyerekanwa kenshi ryaco mumuziki, amareresi, inyandiko no mumigenzo vyarafashije igisagara n'ivyibutso vyaco kumenyekana kw'isi yose.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco yarateje imbere igice kinini c'inyubakwa z'iratiro hamwe n'amahoteri menshi, uburiro, hamwe n'inzu z'amanama zo kurwego rwambere.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco ni kandi kimwe mu bibanza vyiza mugihugu kukundi guteka kwo muri Aziya: kwo muri Koreya, kwo muri Thai, kwo Mubuhinde, no Mubuyapani.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Gutemberera i Walt Disney World bifatwa nk'urugendo rukuru kumiryango myinshi y'Abanyamerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Urugendo "rumenyerewe" rugizwe no kuja Kukibuga Mpuzamakungu c'i Orlando, ukugenda n'ibisi mw'ihoteri yaho i Disney, kumara hafi indwi atakuva munyubakwa za Disney, hamwe no gusubira imuhira.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Hari insiguro nyinshi cane gose zishoboka, gusa iki gisigara arico abantu benshi baba bashatse gusigura iyo bavuze "kuja i Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Amatike menshi agurishirijwe k'umurongo ngurukanabumenyi hakoreshejwe imbuga ngurukana bumenyi zo kugurisha icamunara nka eBay canke Craigslist aba ari itike za parike z'iminsi myinshi zakoreshejwe igice.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Naho iki ari igikorwa kimenyerwe cane, kirabujijwe na Disney: amatike ntashobora guhanahanwa.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Gucumbika ukwo ari kwo kwose musi y’uruzitiro i Grand Canyon bisaba uruhusha rwo gucumbika hagati mu gihugu.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Impusha ni nke ku mvo zo gukingira ikiyaya, zikaboneka ku munsi wa 1 w’ukwezi, amezi ane imbere y'ukwezi batangurirako.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Rero, uruhusha rwo gucumbika mu gihugu hagati ku musi uwo ari wo wose wo gutangurirako muri Rusama rushobora kuboneka kuva itariki 1 Nzero.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Ibibanza vyo mu bice bizwi cane nka Bright Angel Campgound iri hafi ya Phantom Ranch, mu bisanzwe bifatwa vyose n'ababisaba kw’itariki ya mbere batangurirako kubikisha ibibanza.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Hari igitigiri ntarengwa c’impusha zihabwa abisabira kugendagenda, zikaba zihabwa abatanga abandi kuhashika.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ukwinjira muri Afurika y'Epfo n'imodoka ni uburyo bwiza cane bwo kubona ubwiza bwose bwako karere hamwe no kuja mubibanza bitamenyerewe mu ngendo z'ingenzi.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Ibi bishobora gukorwa mumodoka isanzwe hamwe n'ugutegekanya kwiza mugabo i 4x4 irahanuwe cane kandi ibice vyinshi bishikirwa gusa na 4x4 z'uburebure buri hejuru.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Gumiza mumutwe mugihe co gutegekanya ko naho Afurika y'Epfo itekanye atari ibihugu bigenzi vyose bimeze uko.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Ibisabwa hamwe n'ibiciro vya viza bitandukana igihugu kukindi kandi biraterwa n'igihugu uvuyemwo.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Igihugu cose kandi gifise amategeko cisangije asaba ibikoresho vy'ubutabazi bwihuse bibwirizwa kuba biri mumodoka.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ni igisagara c' igice c' uburengero bwa Zimbabwe, kurundi ruhande n' urubibe rwa Livingstone, na Zambia, hamwe n' impande ya Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Igisagara kiri neza na neza impande y' amasumo y' amazi, kandi arakwega ingenzi, ariko icokibanza c' iratiro kizwi kiraraha inkerebutsi hamwe n' ingenzi akaryo ko kuhamara umwanya muremure.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Mugihe c' imvura (Munyonyo na Ntwarante), amazi araba menshi cane hama Amasumo agatera ubwoba gose.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Muba mubwirizwa kujoba iyo muciye kukiraro canke iyo muciye mutuyira turi impande y' Amasumo.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Kurundi ruhande, ni kubera nyene amazi aba yaduze muburebure ukubona amasumo ubwayo aba yijimye—nayo mazi yose.
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Imva ya Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 ishobora kuba imva izwi cane mu mva zo mukabande, ireresi y' ubuvumbuzi bwa Howard Carter mu 1922 uruhafu rw' ibwami rukimeze neza rw' umwami akiri muto.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Ugereranije n' izindi mva nyinshi z' ibwami, vyongeye, imva ya Tutankhamun biragoye kuyigendera, ni nto cane hamwe nuko idasharije cane.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Umuntu wese yumva yoraba ibimenyetso vy' ukwononekara kw' ikiziga bitewe n' amageragezwa yo gukurayo isandugu azobabara kuko ni umutwe n' ibitugu vyonyene vyaboneka.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Ubutunzi budasanzwe bw' uruhafu ntibwarimwo, ariko vyarungitswe mukibanza c' iratiro i Kayiro.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ingenzi zifise umwanya muto vyoba vyiza zimaze umwanya ahandi.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, ku birometero 12 m' ubumanuko bushira uburengero bwa Siem Reap. Ugwo rusengero rwo kugasongero rwubatswe mumpera y' ikinjana c'i 9, ku ntwaro y' Umwami Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ikirere kibabaje c' urusengero n'ingene ubona kukiyaga ca Tonle Sap bituma kuduga k' umusozi bikwiye.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ukugendera ikibanza bishobora kuba vyiza bijanye nukuja mubwato ugana kukiyaga.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Ugwinjiriro rwa Angkor rurakenewe kugira winjire m' urusengero, ubwo rero ntiwibagire mureke arengane yawe mugihe mwinjiriye ahagana i Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalemu n' umugwa mukuru kandi kikaba n' igisagarsa gikuru ca Isirayeli, nubwo ibindi bihugu vyinshi hamwe n' Umuryango w' Ibihugu bitaremeza ko ari umugwa mukuru wa Isirayeli.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Igisagara ca kera c' Imisozi ya Yuda gifise akahise gatangaje gafata ibihumbi vy' imyaka.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Igisagara ni ceranda kuma dini atatu yemera Imana imwe - Abayuda, aba Kristu, aba Isilamu, kandi kikaba ihuriro ry' ukwemera, amadini hamwe n' akaranga.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Kubera insiguro y'amadini y'igisagara, hamwe na cane cane ubwinshi bw' ibibanza Bishaje vy' Igisagara, Yeruzalemu ni hamwe mubibanza bikuru vy' ingenzi vya Isirayeli.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yeruzalemu ifise ibibanza vyinshi vya kera, ibisigaratongo hamwe n'ibice vy'uturanga, vyongeye amahuriro y' ubudandaji yuzuye kandi akora cane, amakawa, hamwe n' uburiro.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekwateri isaba abenegihugu ba Cuban guhabwa ugwete rw' ubutumire imbere yuko binjira muri Ekwateri baciye mubibuga vy' indege mpuza makungu canke aho babemerera kumbibe.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ugo rwete rutegerezwa kwemezwa n' Ubushikiranganji bw' Ubudandaji n' Amahanga bwo muri Ekwateri, kandi rikubahiriza ibisabwa bimwe bimwe.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ayo ma tegeko acungera urugero rw' abimukira rwatunganijwe hagati y' ibihugu bibiri.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Abene gihugu ba Cuban bafise ikarata y' ugwatsi rutoto ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe barashobora kugendera Ubuserukizi bwa Ekwateri kugira barekurirwe kudakenera ivyo bisabwa.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Mureke arengane yanyu itegerezwa kuba isigaje nimiburiburi amezi atandatu imbere y'amatariki yo gufata urugendo. Itike igenda/igaruka irakenewe kugira mwerekane ikiringo muzohamara.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ingendo zirazimbutse kumigwi minini, nukuvuga nkiyo urumwe canke murikumwe n' umugenzi umwe, gerageza guhura n' abandi hama mugire umugwi wa bane canke batandatu kugira muronke igiciro ciza kumuntu umwumwe.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Vyongeye, ico ntigitegerezwa kubatera amakenga, kubera ko ubu ingenzi zihutira kwuzura imiduga.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Ni nk' uburyo bwo guhubisha abantu mukubizeza ko bategerezwa gutanga menshi.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Amaja hejuru y' uburaruko bwa Machu Picchu hari uwo musozi ugoye, kenshi ugwa kumafoto y' ivyasambutse.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Gasa nagateye ubwoba urabiye hasi, kandi ni akadugo kagumye kandi kagoye kuduga, ariko abantu benshi bameze neza barashobora kubikora hafi muminota 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Amabuye arunze k' urukikirwa rw' inzira, no mubice bigumye, imigozi y' ivyuma yo itanga aho kwifadikiza n'amaboko.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ivyo vyavuzwe, nimwitege kubura impemu, hama mugabe mubice bigumye, cane cane iyo bikanye, kubera hashobora kuba nabi cane ningoga na ningoga.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Hariyo isenga ritoyi impande y' agasongero kabwirizwa gucwamwo, kari kasi kandi karapfunganye.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kwihweza ibibanza n'ibidukikije vya Galapagos bikorwa neza mubwato, nkuko Charles Darwin yabikoze mu 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ubwato bwo kwiyunguruza buratembera amazi ya Galapagos - ufatiye kubunini kuva ku 8 gushika kw'i 100 b'ingenzi.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Abantu benshi baribikira ibibanza imbere neza y' igihe (kuberako amato aba yuzuye mugihe ca benshi).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Raba neza ko umuntu mwaciyeko mukubikisha ibibanza ari umuhinga wa Galapagos afise ubumenyi bukwiye bw'ubwato bwinshi butandukanye.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Ivyo bizofasha ko inyungu zanyu bwite na/canke ingorane bihuzwa n'ubwato bubabereye.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Imbere y' umuzo w' aba Espanyole mukinjana ca 16, uburaruko bwa Shiri bwatwarwa n' aba Inca mugihe abasangwa butaka ba Araucani (Mapuche) baba hagati no m' ubumanuko bwa Shiri.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Aba Mapuche bari bamwe kandi mumigwi y' abasangwa butaka y'Abanyamerika bigenga, batigezwe baganzwa akagirire n' itegeko Kuvuga-Igisupanyore inyuma y' ukwikukira kwa Shiri.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Naho Shiri yemeje ukwikukira kwayo mu 1810 (hagati mu ntambara za Napoleon zasize Espanye ata butegetsi nabumwe bukora mumyaka itari mike), intsinzi nyayo kuba Espanyole bayironse 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: République dominicaine (mu ki-esupanyore: República Dominicana) ni igihugu ca Karayibe kiri ku gice c’uburasirazuba bw’izinga rya Hispaniola gisangiye na Hayiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Uretse inkengera z'umusenyi wera n’ikirere c’imisozi, iki gihugu ni co kirimwo igisagara ca kera c’ikinyaburayi mu bice vya Amerika, ubu akaba ari igice ca Saint Domingue.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Mu ntango, iryo zinga ryabamwo Abatayino n'Abanyakarayibe. Abanyakarayibe bari abantu bavuga iki arawakani bari bashitse nko mu 10.000 imbere y'ivuka rya Yezu Kirisu.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Mu myaka mike cane inyuma y'aho abashakashatsi b'Abanyaburaya bashikiye, abanyagihugu b'Abatayino bari baramaze kugabanurwa cane n'abari bahihagiye bava mu gihugu ca Esupanye.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Twisunze ibivugwa na Fray Bartolome de las Casa (Tradato de las Indias), hagati ya 1492 na 1498 ba mukerarugendo bihagira uturere baturuka muri Esupanye bishe Abatayino boba bangana 100.000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. icokibanza cubatswe nk' ikibuga c' inzu y' abihebeye Imana mukinjana ca 17, harimwo Templo de San Diego niyo nzu yonyene ya kera ikiriho.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Ikora ubu nk' ikibanza co hagati kandi hama hariyo ibintu biriko birakorwa, kumurango no mwijoro.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Hari uburiro butari buke bukikuje umurima, hama inyuma y' umuhingamo no k' umugoroba, ibiteramo vya gusa vyama bikorwa guhera kuri gazebo yo hagati.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Inzira yo Gusomana). Ivyumba vyo hejuru bibiri btandukanijwe ni santimetero 69 zonyene birimwo ikirango ca kera c' urukundo.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Kuma faranga y' ibiceri, abana bamwe bamwe bazokubwira inkuru.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Abantu barakunda kuja kw'izina rya Bowen ku murango canke muri wikendi. Hari ivyo gusoza ubwato, gutembera mu misozi, amaduka, uburiro n'ibindi.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Ni ahantu nyaho hari mu kigobe citwa Howe kiri hirya ya Vancouver, hakaba horoshe gushika ufashe tagisi y'ubwato kw'izinga Granville mu gisagara ca Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Abakunda gukorera utuntu hanze bakwiye gufata inzira yitwa Sea to Sky.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: I Whistler (ahagenzwa isaha 1 n'inusu uvuye i Vancouver mu muduga) harazimvye mugabo harazwi cane kubera amahiganwa ya Jeux olympiques d'hiver yo mu 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Mu rushana, ryohererwa ico kibanza kiri mu bibanza vya mbere bikorerwamwo urukino rwa ski muri Amerika ya Ruguru, mu ci na ho wigire kunyonga ikinga mu misozi.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Utegerezwa kubikisha itike hakiri kare. Udafise iyo tike, ntushobora kurara i Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ni co kirindiro conyene c'abarinzi b'ishamba gitanga uburyamo n'imfungurwa zishushe, turetse ivyo kwemerera abantu kuhashinga amahema. I La Leona, San Pedrillo, n'i Los Patos urashobora kuhashinga ihema gusa mugabo nta mfungurwa batanga.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Urashobora kugura itike yo kwinjira mw'iparike aho nyene ku kirindiro c'abarinzi i Puerto Jiménez, mugabo ntibakira amakarata y'ingurane.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Abajewe iparike (MINAE) ntibatanga amatike hasigaye ikiringo kirenga ukwezi ngo ujeyo.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Kuri CafeNet El Sol urashobora gufatisha ikibanza ku madolari 30 y'amanyamerika, canke amadolari 10 uhamara umusi umwe. Ido n'ido ni ku rupapuro rwabo rwa Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Amazinga ya Cook ni igihugu co mu mazi gifitaniye na Nouvelle Zélande ubucuti burimwo ukwidegemvya, kikaba kiri muri Polynésie, hagati mw'ibahari Pasifike yo mu Bumanuko.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Kigizwe n'amazinga 15 akwiragiye mw'ibahari ahangana n'ibilometero kwadarato birenga imiliyoni 2,2.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Kubera ko ayo mazinga asangiye amasaha na Hawayi, ahora rimwe na rimwe yitwa "Hawayi yo hepfo".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Naho ari hato, haributsa bamwebamwe mu batama bahagendera ingene i Hawayi hari hameze imbere yo kwita leta, hataraza amahoteli manini y'ingenzi n'irindi terambere.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Amazinga ya Cook ntagira ibisagara binini, ahubwo agizwe n'amazinga 15. Makuru ni Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ubu mu bihugu biteye imbere, gutanga ubararo vyo ku rwego rwo hejuru n'icayi bisigaye ari ubuhinga.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Abakora ivy'uburaro bo ku rwego rwo hejuru, usanga bahiganwa canecane mu bintu bibiri: uburaro n'icayi co mu gitondo.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Mu bigize icayi co mu gitondo hoshobora kuba harimwo udufungurwa turyoshe two muri ako karere tuboneka mu bihe bimwebimwe, canke utundi dufungurwa tudasanzwe dutegurwa na nya hoteri.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Mu bigize icayi co mu gitondo hoshobora kuba harimwo udufungurwa turyoshe two muri ako karere tuboneka mu bihe bimwebimwe, canke utundi dufungurwa tudasanzwe dutegurwa na nya hoteli.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Ico kibanza hari igihe usanga ari inyubakwa ya kera irimwo ibikoresho vyizavyiza vya kera, hasi hatunganijwe neza cane hamwe n'amazi yo kwogamwo.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kwinjira mu muduga wawe ugafata urugendo rurerure mw'ibarabara hari ukuntu biryoshe kubera bidasaba ibintu birebire.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Umuduga wawe si cokimwe n'ibiduga binini kuko wowo ushobora kuba umenyereye kuwunyonga, uzi n'ubushobozi bwawo.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Gushinga ihema mu rugo rw'umuntu canke mu gisagara uko kingana kwose, vyoshobora gukwega amaso y'abantu bidakenewe.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Muri make, gukoresha umuduga wawe ni uburyo bwiza cane bwo gufata urugendo mw'ibarabarara, mugabo si uburyo bwiza bwo "gucumbika".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Gucumbikisha umuduga wawe bishoboka igihe ufise umuduga munini ufise ibibanza vy'inyuma, insimbabisaka, umuduga w'ubwoko bwa berline canke w'inyuma harehare ufise intebe zizingika.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Amahoteri amwamwe ni ayo mu gihe hari haharawe amagariyamoshi n'amato njabukabahari ya kera, imbere y'Intambara ya kabiri y'isi yose, mu kinjana ca 19 no mu ntango z'ica 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ayo mahoteli ni yo abatunzi n'abantu rurangiranwa b'ico gihe bashikiramwo, kenshi bakaronka imfungurwa nziza cane n'ibirori vy'ijoro.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Ibisharizo vyaho vya kera, kuba ata bintu bigezweho biriyo, n'ukuramba kwaho guteye igomwe, biri mu biharanga.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Naho kenshi usanga ari amazu y'umuntu ku giti ciwe, hari igihe yakira abakuru b'ibihugu b'abashitsi n'abandi banyacubahiro.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Ingenzi yifitiye akanoti yoshobora kugura iteke y'indege izoyishikana kw'isi yose, ikaza irashikira muri menshi muri ayo mahoteli.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Urunani rw'uguhana amakuru n'ingenzi ni ishirahamwe rihuza ingenzi n'ababa mu bisagara zipfuza kujamwo.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kwinjira mu runani nk'urwo kenshi bisaba gusa kwuzuza urukaratasi kuri internet. Ariko hari igihe bakubwira ko ushaka ushobora gutanga ayandi makuru canke bakabigusaba.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Uca uhabwa urutonde ku rukaratasi canke kuri internet rw'ababa aho hantu bashobora kukwakira, rimwe na rimwe hakaba hariko n'amazina y'abo bakoranye n'ico izindi ngenzi zabavuzeko.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Guhabwa indaro ukaryama kw'ikanape vyatangujwe muri Nzero 2004 igihe umuhinga mu vy'inyabwonko yitwa Casey Fenton yaronka indege ya make ija muri Isilande mugabo akabura uburaro.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Yaciye yandikira ubutumwa ngurukanabumenyi abanyeshure bo kuri kaminuza yaho, benshi cane baramwishura bamubwira ko bomuha indaro ku buntu.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Amahoteli yitwa auberges kenshi aha indaro abakiri bato, canecane abafise imyaka iri hagati ya mirongibiri na mirongitatu. Mugabo kenshi urahasanga n'abakuze.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Imiryango ifise abana si kenshi uyihasanga, mugabo amahoteli amwamwe nk'ayo usanga abakirira mu vyumba vyihariwe.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Igisagara ca Beijing mu Bushinwa kizokwakira Inkino za Olempike zo mu rushana mu 2022, kikazoba kibaye igisagara ca mbere cakiriye inkino za Olempike zo mu ci n'izo mu rushana.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: I Beijing ni ho hazobera ibirori vyo gutangura n'ivyo gusozera, hamwe n'inkino zibera ku bibarafu indani mu nyubakwa zabigenewe.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Izindi nkino za ski zizobera ku kibuga ca ski citwa Taizicheng i Zhangjiakou, nko ku bilometero 220 (mayiri 140) uvuye i Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Nyinshi mu nsengero zaho ziragira Isabukuru itangura muri Munyonyo ikarangira hagati muri Rusama, bikavana n'ikirangamisi c'umwaka ca buri rusengero.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Igihe kinini c'ayo masabukuru y'urusengero kiba gihuye n'isabukuru ya nya rusengero canke ivuka ry'ikimana nyamukuru caho canke ikindi kintu gihambaye kijanye n'urwo rusengero.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Amasabukuru y'urusengero rwa Kerala araryoshe kuraba, ukama ubona inzovu zasharijwe zirengana, umugwi w'abacuraranzi b'urusengero, n'ibindi birori.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Ihayanishwa mpuzamakungu (irikunda kwitwa Ihayanishwa ry'isi yose, canke Ihayanishwa gusa) ni isabukuru mpuzamakungu y'ubuhinga n'utugenegene.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Ibihugu biyigiramwo uruhara birerekana utugenegene n'ibindi bintu vyigisha, bikabera mu bibanza buri gihugu cahawe. Barerekana ibibazo vyo kw'isi canke imico na kahise vy'igihugu cabo.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Amahayanishwa mpuzamakungu y'ivy'ubusitani ni ibirori bidasanzwe aho berekana amashurwe, imirima y'abahinga n'ibindi vyose bijanye n'ibiterwa.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Naho mu bisanzwe bishoboka ko biba buri mwaka (bikabera mu bihugu bitandukanye), mu vy'ukuri si ko bigenda.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Ivyo birori bikunda kumara hagati y'amezi atatu n'atandatu, bikabera ahangana n'amahegitari 50 canke arenga.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Mu myaka n'iyindi, hari ingero nyinshi zitandukanye za filime zagiye zirakoreshwa. Iza mm 35 (negatife za mm 36 kuri 24) ni zo zimenyerewe cane.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Kenshi usanga vyoroshe kuronka iyindi filime iguheranye, kandi isohora amafoto twovuga ko abona nk'ay'icuma gifotora kigezweho.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Ivyuma bifotora bigereranye bijamwo filime bimwebimwe usanga bijamwo filime ya cm 6 kuri 6 cm, ni ukuvuga negatife za mm 56 kuri 56.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Ivyo bituma amafoto asumba incuro nka zine aya firime za mm 35 (mm kwadarato 3136, iyindi na yo 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Gufotora ibikoko ni kimwe mu bintu bigoye cane ku mufotozi. Bisaba amahirwe, kwihangana, kumenyera hamwe n'ibikoresho vyiza.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Gufotora ibikoko usanga kenshi babifata ibisanzwe, mugabo cokimwe n'ayandi mafoto muri rusangi, ifoto ivuga vyinshi gusumba amajambo menshi.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Gufotora ibikoko bisaba kenshi kuba icuma gifotora c'imbone ibona kure cane, naho gufotora ibindi nk'umugwi w'inyoni canke akaremwa gatoyi cane bisaba izindi mbone.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ibikoko vyinshi vyo mu mahanga usanga bitoroshe kubona, kandi hari igihe amaparike usanga afise amategeko ajanye no gufata amafoto yo guca amahera.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Ibikoko vyo mw'ishamba bishobora kugira udusoni canke gukara. Ahantu biba hashobora kuba hakanye, hashushe canke hagoye mu bundi buryo.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Kw'isi hari indimi zirenga 5.000 zitandukanye, izirenga mirongibiri muri zo zikaba zivugwa n'abantu imiliyoni 50 canke barenga.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Kandi amajambo yanditse kenshi aroroha gutahura gusumba ayavuzwe gusa, canecane nk'igihe ari aderese, aho usanga kenshi aderese zigoye kwatura neza.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Hari ibihugu vyinshi usanga bivuga neza icongereza, mu bindi vyinshi cane ugasanga baragerageza, na canecane urwaruka.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Iyumvire gato nk'umuntu w'i Manchester, uw'i Boston, uwo muri Jamayika n'uw'i Sidine bariko barasangira udufungurwa two ku mugoroba mw'iresitora i Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Bariko batera inkuru zo mu bisagara iwabo, bakazivuga n'inyaturo zabo zitandukanye, bashiramwo n'ak'iwabo.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Mu bisanzwe gusumira mu maduka manini y'imfungurwa ni bwo buryo bworoshe bwo kuronka ico urya. Udashobora guteka, uca usanga ubwirizwa kugura indya zitetse.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Amaduka menshi y'imfungurwa asigaye afise imfungurwa zitetse z'ubwoko butandukanye. Hari n'aho usanga hari micro-ondes canke ikindi cuma gishusha indya.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Mu bihugu bimwebimwe canke mu maduka amwamwe, usanga hari n'imiburiburi resitora imwe muri ico kibanza nyene, kenshi ikaba isanzwe cane izimbutse.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Fotora amasezerano ugendane kopi yayo hamwe n'amakuru y'ingene wotora abo waguzeko asiransi.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Barakeneye kwerekana izina ry'agasandugu k'ubutumwa ngurukanabumenyi k'abo waguzeko asiransi na telefone zabo mpuzamakungu kugira bahanuze canke basabe uruhusha, bagire n'ivyo basaba.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Iyindi kopi yibike mu mizigo yawe no kuri internet (nuyirungikire mu butumwa ngurukanabumenyi, canke uyibike mu "bubiko bwo kuri internet").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Nimba ugendana imashini nyabwonko canke tablette, bika ikopi muri ico cuma (ku buryo wogishikira ata internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Vyongeye, abo mufadikanije urugendo hamwe n'incuti n'abagenzi bo muhira boshima kugufasha, nubahe ikopi y'ayo mategeko n'ayo makuru afasha gutora umuntu.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Impongo zitwa élans (canke wapiti) ntizisanzwe zikara, mugabo zibonye ko zigeramiwe zica zirwanira.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Igihe abantu batabona ko izo mpongo zishobora kubagirira nabi, barashobora kuzegera cane bakishira mu kaga.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Uranywa inzoga wigerera. Inzoga ntitugirako ingaruka cokimwe, kandi kumenya aho ugeze birahambaye cane.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Mu ngaruka z'igihe kirekire inzoga nyinshi zishobora kugira ku magara yacu harimwo ukwonona igitigu, eka n'uruhumyi be n'urupfu. Inzoga zitemewe n'amategeko zozo zirongereza akaga.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Inzoga zikaze zitemewe n'amategeko hari igihe usanga zirimwo imicafu itandukanye iteye akaga, nka méthanol, iyishobora gutera uruhumyi canke urupfu naho iba ari nkeyi.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Amarori arashobora kuzimbuka mu kindi gihugu, canecane mu bihugu bikenye aho usanga abakozi bahembwa make.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Uriyumvira kwipimisha amaso ukiri iwanyu, canecane nimba asiransi ibikurihira, maze ivyo umuganga yakwandikiye uzovyibangikanye ubikoreshe ugeze ahandi.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Montire z'amarori nziza cane kandi z'ubwoko bwemewe ziboneka aho hantu ushobora gusanga zifise ingorane zibiri: zimwe zishobora kuba ari inyiganano, iz'ukuri zavuye hanze ugasanga zirazimvye gusumba iwanyu.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Ikawa ni kimwe mu bintu bidandazwa cane kw'isi, kandi aho iwanyu ushobora kuba wohasanga ubwoko butandukanye.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Mugabo kw'isi hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kunywa ikawa buryoshe kugerageza.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Ivyo bita canyoning ni ukumanuka epfo mu mwonga wumye canke wuzuyemwo amazi.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Ukwo kumanuka mu mwonga kujamwo ivyo kwoga, kwurira no gusimba. Mugabo kubitangura bisaba ko bakwigisha gatoyi canke ko uba unonotse (ugereranije no kwurira umusozi w'urutare, kwibira mu mazi ufise ibigufasha guhema canke kugira ivya ski yo mu misozi, nk'akarorero).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Gutembera n'amaguru ni ukugendagenda muca mu bidukikije, kenshi mukabigira muciye mu tuyira bakunda gucamwo.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Urugendo rw'umusi umwe ni ugutambuka ahareha na mayiri imwe canke nyinshi woshobora kugenda mu musi umwe.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Urugendo rw'umusi umwe uca ahantu horoshe ntirusaba imyiteguro myinshi, kandi umuntu anonotse bisanzwe arashobora kubikora.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Imiryango irimwo abana batoyi yoshobora gukenera imyiteguro yiyongereye, mugabo birashoboka ko muja gutembera hanze naho mwoba mufise inzoya canke abana bataragera kuja kw'ishure.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Kw'isi yose, hari amashirahamwe hafi 20 atunganya ivyo kwiruka. Menshi arigenga.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Go Running Tours, iryasubiriye Global Running Tours, rihuza imigwi itari mike y'abakora ivyo kwiruka babijanisha no gutembera, ku migabane ine y'isi.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ryakomotse kuri Running Tours Barcelona ry'i Barcelone na Running Copenhagen ry'i Copenhague. Running Tours Prague hamwe n'ayandi ntiyatevye kuryiyungako.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Imbere yo gufata urugendo n'igihe ururiko, hari ibintu vyinshi ukwiye kwiyumvira.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ufashe urugendo, niwitege ko ibintu biza kuba bitandukanye n'uko biri "iwanyu". Ingene abaho bifata, amategeko, imfungurwa, uruja n'uruza, uburaro, ivyo bisunga, ururimi n'ibindi, usanga bitandukanye n'ivy'iwanyu ku rugero kanaka.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ico ni ikintu ukwiye kwama wibuka kugira woye kuvunika umutima canke mbere ngo ushishwe n'ingene abaho bakora ibintu.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Amashirahamwe atunganya ingendo yamyeho kuva nko mu kinjana ca 19. Uwukora mu vy'ingendo kenshi aba kirumara igihe ruba ari urugendo rutandukanye n'izo wari umaze kugira, mu bijanye n'akarere uzoba ugiyemwo, imico kama, ururimi canke ibihugu bikenye.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Naho amashirahamwe atunganya ingendo usanga ashobora gutunganya ingendo zisanzwe nka zose, menshi usanga yibanda ku bwoko kanaka bw'ingendo, ku bantu bafise amikoro kanaka no ku bihugu kanaka bajamwo.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Vyiza wokwitura abatunganya ingendo bama batunganya ingendo zimeze nk'urwo wipfuza kugira.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Tereza akajisho ku rubuga rwabo canke kw'idirisha ry'aho bakorera, urabe ingendo bahayanisha.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Nimba wipfuza gutembera utarishe menshi kubera amikoro make, canke kubera ko ari ko ubayeho canke wipfuza kubigerageza, hari uburyo bumwebumwe wobikora.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Muri make, buri mu migwi ibiri: wokora akazi uri ku rugendo, canke ukagerageza kuziganya amahera. Iki kiganiro gishimika kuri ico ca kabiri.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Wipfuza guheba ivyo kworoherwa, umwanya n'ivyo umenyereye kugira uzokoreshe amahera make ashoboka, raba ivyo kugira ingendo za make.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Mu gutanga iyo mpanuro, vyitezwe ko uwufata urugendo atiba, adahonyanga amategeko, ataja mu vya magendo, adasega canke ngo arye imitsi abandi ku nyungu yiwe bwite.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Igihe wururutse indege, ubwato canke iyindi ngendeshwa, kenshi ahantu ha mbere ushikira ni ku baraba ivy'imipaka.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Mu magariyamoshi amwamwe ajabuka imbibe, isuzuma ry'ivya ngombwa ribera mw'igariyamoshi iri ku rugendo, ukaba ukwiye kuba ufise ibikuranga bitomoye igihe wurira mwene iyo gariyamoshi.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Mw'igariyamoshi ifise uburyamo, uwuyitwara arashobora kubasaba pasiporo kugira ntibirirwe barakuvyura.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Kwiyandikisha ni ikindi gisabwa mu bijanye na viza. Mu bihugu bimwebimwe, usabwa kumenyesha abajejwe intwaro ko uba mu karere batwara, ukababwira na aderese y'aho uba.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Hari igihe bisaba ko wuzuza urukaratasi ku gituro c'inyamiramabi canke ukaja ku biro biraba abinjira n'abasohoka mu gihugu.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Mu bihugu vyinshi bifise mwene iryo tegeko, amahoteri usanga ari yo akora ivyo vyo kwiyandikisha (wibuke kubaza).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Ahandi usanga abatashikiye mu buraro bw'ingenzi ari bo gusa bakenera kwiyandikisha. Kubera ko ivyo bituma itegeko ridatomoka, vyiza rero worondera amakuru kare.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Architecture iraba ibijanye n'ugutegura imigero y'inyubakwa no kwubaka. Ingene inyubakwa yubatswe ubwavyo ni ikintu gikunda gukwega ingenzi.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Inyubakwa nyinshi usanga ziteye igomwe, kandi birashobora kuryoha kwitegereza ahantu uhagaze mw'igorofa ndende canke kw'idirisha ryashizwe ahantu hiyumviriwe neza.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Ivyo gutunganya imigero no kwubaka birinjiranamwo cane n'ibindi bisata, nk'ivyo gutunganya igisagara, gutunganya inyubakwa za leta, ivy'utugenegene, ivy'ugushariza mu nzu no gutunganya neza ubusitani.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Kubera ukuntu ibigwati vy'Abanyamerika b'imvukira biri kure, ntuzoronka aho wisamariza neza mw'ijoro utagiye i Albuquerque canke i Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Ariko ibibanza vy'amakazino nka vyose vyavuzwe haruguru bitanga ibinyobwa, kandi mu bitari bike muri vyo usanga hari ivyo kwisamaza bisohorwa n'amashirahamwe kanaka (canecane ibibanza bininibinini vyegereye Albuquerque na Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Uraba maso: ububare bwaho bwo mu dusagara dutoduto ntibwama ari bwiza ku ngenzi zivuye mu yindi leta.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Kimwe coco, mu buraruko bwa Nouveau-Mexique hari ingorane zikomeye zijanye n'abatwara umuduga baborewe, kandi benshi muri bo ni abo mu micungararo y'ububare bwo mu dusagara dutoyi.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Amashusho canke ivyandiko bidakenewe vyo ku ruhome vyitwa graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Naho atari ikintu ca vuba cane, abantu benshi bashobora kuba babisanisha na birya urwaruka rukora rwonona ibibanza rusangi n'ivya barundi mu gupuriza irangi.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Ariko rero, muri iki gihe hari abahinga ba mwene ayo mashusho yo ku ruhome, imisi mikuri ihariwe ayo mashusho hamwe n'impome "zemewe n'amategeko". Amashusho yo ku ruhome nk'ayo usanga kenshi asa n'utugenegene aho gusa n'ivy'abiyadukiza.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Gutera agakoni utera kakakugarukako ni ubuhinga ingenzi nyinshi zipfuza kumenya.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Ushaka kumenya ingene batera ako gakoni kagenda kakakugaruka mu kuboko kwawe, raba neza ko ufise agakoni kabishoboye.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Twinshi mu dukoni nk'utwo tuboneka muri Ositaraliya ntitugaruka uduteye. Abagitangura kwiga vyiza bokwirinda kugatera iyo hari umuyaga.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Imfungurwa zitwa hangi igihe zateguriwe mu ziko ryo mu kinogo.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Ico kinono bagishiramwo amabuye ashushe bakuye mu mucanwa canke kigashuha kubera ubushuhe bwivira mu kuzimu mu bibanza bimwebimwe.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Ubwo buhinga bwa hangi bukunda gukoreshwa mu gutara imfungurwa kavukire zo ku mugoroba.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Hari ibibanza bitari bike batangamwo imfungurwa za hangi zategujwe umuriro uva mu kuzimu. Izindi mfungurwa za hangi ushobora kuzihonja i Christchurch, i Wellington n'ahandi.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail ifise ubwoko bubiri bw'ivyicaro mu magariyamoshi yunguruza abakozi i Cape Town no mu micungararo yaho: MetroPlus (ari wo Mugwi wa mbere) na Metro (ari wo Mugwi wa gatatu).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Muri MetroPlus hameze neza kandi abantu ntibuzurana mugabo harazimvye gato, naho hazimbutse gusumba amatike asanzwe ya gariyamoshi z'i Europe.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Igariyamoshi yose irafise ibiduga vya MetroPlus n'ivya Metro. Ibiduga vya MetroPlus vyama biri ku mpera ya gariyamoshi yegereye cane Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Gutwaza abandi - Ntiwigere ukura ijisho ku masakoshi yawe, canecane igihe uriko ujabuka imbibe mpuzamakungu.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Woshobora gusanga uriko utwaza uwundi ibiyayuramutwe utabizi, bikagukwegera.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Aho harimwo no gutonda murindiriye, narirya imbwa zimotereza ibiyayuramutwe zishobora gukoreshwa umwanya n'umwanya, mutategujwe.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Ibihugu bimwebimwe birahasha rwose n'ababa bakoze amakosa ari ryo rya mbere. Urashobora gupfungwa imyaka irenga 10 canke ukicwa.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Amasakoshi adacunzwe arakarirwa n'ibisuma kandi arashobora gutuma abakuru bikeka ko yoba arimwo ibombe.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Iwanyu, kubera ko uba usanzwe ubana n'imigera yaho, birashoboka cane ko umubiri wawe umaze kuyimenyera.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Mugabo ugiye mu yindi mihingo y'isi, birashoboka cane ko ugira ingorane kubera ko utaba umenyereye udukoko dutera indwara twaho.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Vyongeye, mu mihingo ishushe usanga udukoko dutera indwara tugwira ningoga tukanaramba tutari mu mubiri.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Ni yo mpamvu habayeho ibiza vyiswe ngo Ako mu nda k'i Delhi, Umuvumo wa Farawo, Ukwihora kwa Montezuma, n'ibindi nk'ivyo.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Nka kurya abantu bagira ingorane zo guhema mu ntara zikanye cane, ni ko no mu ntara zishushe bakunda kurwara ako mu nda. Kenshi karababaza mugabo ntikaba gateye akaga vy'ukuri.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Iyo mugiye ubwambere mu gihugu kiri munzira y' amajambere, - canke mu gice gishashaa c' isi - ntimusuzugure ugushobora kudahuza n'akaranga kaho.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Abatemberezi benshi bakunda gutembera kandi bakerebutse bararengewe na gishasha c' ingendo zo mu bihugu biri mwiterambere, aho ukumenyera akaranga kwa hato na hato gushobora kwiyongera vyihuta.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Cane cane mumisi yanyu yambere, mwisunge kwidagadurira mumazu yakira ingenzi yisunga imico yo Muburengero kandi ameze neza, ibifungurwa hamwe n'ubufasha kugira bibafashe kumenyera akarere gashasha.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ntimusinzirire ku matela canke i matela iri hasi mubice mutazi ibikoko vyaho.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Iyo mugiye muma kambi, itwaze udutanda two mukambi canke udutanda tw'umuvuma kugira bibakingire inzoka, utumina hamwe n' ibindi.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Nimwuzuze inzu yanyu ikawa mugatondo hamwe n' icayi kiruhura kiva mumashurwe ya kamomiye mw'ijoro.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Iyo muri mubiruhuko, muba mufise umwanya wo kwinezereza hamwe nogufata iyi minota yo guteka ikintu kidasanzwe.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Iyo mwiyumva mwobishobora cane, fata ako karyo kugira mukore umutobe canke muvange imitobe y'ivyamwa bitandukanye:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Birashoboka ko muzotora ikinyobwa gisanzwe mwoshobora gukora mugafungura mugatondo iyo muvuye kuvyo mubamwo vyanyu vya misi yose.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Iyo muba mugisagara aho aho akaranga ko kunwa inzoga gahindagurika, gende mu bunywero canke mumazu rusangi yagizwe ububare yo mu birwati mudasanzwe mujamwo.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kubatazi imvugo y' ikiganga, umajambo igwaza na yandukira afise insiguro zitandukanye.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Indwara igwaza ni imwe iterwa n' ikintu kigwaza nka virusi, bagiteri, ikizinu canke akandi gakoko.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Indwara yandukira ni indwara ihahanahnwa vyoroshe iyo hagize uwegera uwuyigwaye.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Amareta menshi ategeka ko ingenzi zinjira, canke abahaba basohotse, ibihugu vyabo bibanje kwicandagisha ingwara zitandukanye.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Ivyo bisabwa kenshi bivana n' ibihugu ingenzi yagendeyemwo canke ashaka kugenderamwo.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Kimwe mubintu bikomeye vya Charlotte, muri Carolina yo m' uburaruko, nuko ifise ubwinshi bw'ibisata vyiza cane vyagenewe imiryango.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ababa mutundi turere bavuga umubano mwiza n'imiryango nk' ikigituma nyamukuru baza kuhaba, hama ingenzi zikabona igisagara ko coroshe kubamwo n' abana mukarere.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Mumyaka 20 iheze, igitigiri c' ibisata bigenewe abana muri Uptown Charlotte cariyongereye k' uburyo bwihuta cane.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ama tagisi ntakoreshwa cane n' imiryango i Charlotte, nubwo ashobora kuba akenewe mubihe bimwe bimwe.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Hariho icongeweko kugira haronkwe ingenzi zirenga zibiri, ni ukuvuga ko ico gisata gishobora kuba kizimvye gusumba uko bikenewe.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antaragitica ni igice c’isi ca mbere gikanye, kikaba gikikuje isonga ryo mu bumanuko ry’isi.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Ingendo z'ingenzi zirazimvye, kandi zisaba ko umuntu aba amagara meza, zishobora kuba mu gihe c’ici gusa kuva muri Munyonyo gushika muri Ruhuhuma, kandi zemewe ahanini kugirwa mu gace k'umugabane kinjira mu mazi, mu mazinga yirebanga, no mu kiyaga Rosi.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Abakozi nk'ibihumbi bikeya baraza gucumbika ng'aha mu ci mu makambi angana mirongo ine n’umunani canecane muri ubwo burere. Bake muri bo barahaguma no mu gihe c'imbeho nyinshi.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Hagati muri Antaragitika ni itaba rigaragara ringana n’ibirometero biri hagati ya 2 na 3 vy’amazi yibumbase nk’ibibarafu.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Rimwerimwe ingendo zo mu kirere z'ubuhinga zirinjira i musozi, mu ntumbero yo gukora imyimenyerezo yo kuduga imisozi canke kugira bashike kw’isonga ry’isi, iryo na ryo rikaba rifise icicariro kinini.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (canke Highway) ni akayira k' ibiro metero 1600 kuva Kugituro McMurdo Kukiyaga ca Ross muri Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ni urubura rufatanijwe n' utunogo twuzuye kandi turangwa n' amabendera. Hashobora kuzungurukwa n'amatingatibga yabigenewe, bakwega utuduga two k' urubura turimwo ibitoro hamwe n' ivya nkenerwa.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Izo ntizoroshe nico gituma inzira itegerezwa kuzunguruka Imisozi ica muri Antarctic kugira ngo ishike k' umugwa.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Ikintu gikunze gutera amasanganya mugihe c'urubura rwinshi ni amabarabara anyerera, amapave (impande y' inzira) cane cane mu ngendo.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Nimiburiburi, mukenera ibirato bifise musi hakozwe kuburyo bwiza. Ibirato vyo muci biranyerera cane k' urubura, kandi n' ibirato vya sekuro vyo mugihe gikanye birakena.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Icitwazo gitegerezwa kuba kirekire bikwiye, mm 5 (1/5 inch) canke zirenga, hamwe n' igikoresho coroshe bikwiye mugihe c' ubukanye.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ibirato bimwe bimwe vya sekuro birafise ibintu bimeze nk' amenyo kandi hariho n' ikindi gikoresho cishimikizwa mugihe hanyerera, kigenewe ibirato bimwe bimwe hamwe nabimwe vya sekuro, vy'amataro canke amataro n'isemere.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Itaro ritegerezwa kuba rigufi kandi ryagutse. Umusenyi, igaraviyo, canke umunyu (calcium chloride) biba bisanzaye kuma barabara canke kutuyira kugira bongereze ugukwega.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Urubura runini ruhenuka bukwi na bukwi si ibidasanzwe; utudugo tugumye dushobora kugumya buke buke gusa, hama ubunini burengako buca bugwa hasi nk'Urubura runini ruhenuka bukwi na bukwi.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Ikibazo nuko urubura ruhomako, biba bisaba imbarutso zimwe kugira rumanuke hasi, hama urubura ruke ruvuyeko rushobora kuba imbarutso y'ibindi vyose bishika.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Rimwe na rimwe igishika ubwambere nk'imbarutso ni izuba rirushusha urubura, rimwe na rimwe ukugwa kw'urundi rubura, rimwe na rimwe ibindi kama bishika, cane cane umuntu.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Ikivumbuzi ni inkingi nyamukuru y' umuyaga uzunguruka ku nguvu zikeya, co cikwegeramwo umuyaga ugikikije hama kikawuduza hejuru.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Bitanguza imiyaga miremire (kenshi intambuko 100 canke 200 kwisaha) kandi birashobora guterura ibintu biremereye mumuyaga, hama bikavyunguruza uko ikivumbuzi ciyunguruza.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Bitangura nk' imibirikira imanuka iva mumiyaga y'gicu, hama bikaba "ibivumbuzi" mugihe bikoze kwisi.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Abatanga VPN kugiti cabo (virtual private network) ni uburyo bwiza bwo kwirinda vyompi ugukumirwa gufatiye kumvo za politike hamwe n'ihagarikwa rifatiye mukarere k'ubudandaji.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Zirarengeye web proxies kubera imvo nyinshi: Zirahindura inzira yose y'abakoresha ubuhinga ngurukana bumenyi, atari http yonyene.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Mubisanzwe zitanga umuyoboro urengana uri hejuru hamwe n'ibikorwa vyiza gusumba. Ziba zikoresha ibanga nico gituma bitoroshe kuzigirako amatohoza.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Amashirahamwe y'amasamirizi arakunda kubesha ku ntumbero yiyi, bakemeza ko ari "ukwirinda ukwibwa".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Bisubiye, amategeko y' akarere ntangaruka afise na nto kukwimura kutemewe n' amategeko; iyimurwa igiharuro kukindi giharuro rya disike rikora neza ku cuma icarico cose aho icakame gikora.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Intumbero yubu ni iyo ukwongerereza ayo mashirahamwe ubugenduzi ku masoko yayo; vyose bifatira kwizunguruka ry'amafaranga.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
