text: Kuberako amahamagarwa aba yahinduriwe ku buhinga ngurukana bumenyi, ntimukeneye gukoresha ishirahamwe ryo gutumatumanako riri aho muba canke aho mutemberera.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Kandi ntagisabwa gihari co kuronka inimero yaho uri ivuye mumugwi mubamwo; mushobora kuronka ubuhinga ngurukana bumenyi buvuye kukigendajuru mugahinga ka Chicken, Alaska hama hitemwo inimero ivuga ko muri musi y' izuba rya Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Kenshi, utegerezwa kugura inimero ikora hose ugutandukanye yemerera amaterefone yo mubwoko bwa PSTN kuguhamagara. Aho inimero iva biratera itandukaniro kubantu baguhamagara.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Apirikasiyo yo guhindura ibisomwa kumwanya kumwanya bwango - Apirikasiyo zishoboye guhindura ubwo nyene uduce duto tw' igisomwa kuva mururimi ruja murundi.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Amwe muma apirikasiyo yo muruwo mugwi arashobora no guhindura ibisomwa mu ndimi zinyamahanga kuvyapa canke kubindi buntu vyo mubuzima bwa minsi yose mugihe uwukoresha smartphone ayirabishije kuri ivyo bintu.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Imoteri zo guhindura indimi zarateye imbere cane, hama ubu zitanga ibihinduwe bikosoye cane canke buke (kandi cane ibidasobanutse), ariko birasaba kwitonderwa, kuberako bishobora kandi kwihenda.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Imwe muma apirikasiyo akomeye cane muri uwo mugwi ni Google Translate, yo yemera ihindurwa utari k' umurongo inyuma yo kuba wabitse ivyangombwa vy'ururimi gwipfuzwa.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Gukoresha apirikasiyo yo kwiyunguruza ya GPS kuri smartphone yanyu birashobora kuba akaryo koroshe kandi keza cane mu kwiyunguruza mugihe muri hanze y' igihugu canyu c' inkomoko.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Birashobora kugufasha kubika amahera ugereranije no kugura amakarata mashasha ya GPS, canke icuma ca GPS cigenga canke gukotesha imwe ukuye mw'ishirahamwe rikotesha imiduga.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Iyo mudafise uburyo bwo kuja k'umurongo ngurukana bumenyi kuri terefone yanyu, canke iri mukibanza cakure, ubushobozi bwayo bushobora kunanirwa canke kutaboneka.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Ubudandarizo bwose buba bwuzuye amakarata menshi acangana ya terefone amaze kurihwa ashobora gukoreshwa mumaterefone barihisha canke terefone isanzwe.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Mugihe ama karata menshi ari meza kuguhamgara ahariho hose, zimwe zigenewe mwitangwa ry' ibiciro vyiza vyo guhamagara kumigwi y' ibihugu izwi.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ugushikira ico gisata bikorwa kenshi bicishijwe ku nimero itarihisha ishobora guhamagarwa ukoresheje amaterefone nka yose atakuriha.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Amategeko araba ubufotozi busanzwe arakoreshwa kandi no mububitsi bw' ireresi, birashoboka kandi no kubindi.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Igihe no gufata ifoto y' ikintu bitemewe, aho ntiwokwiyumvira no kubika ireresi ryaco.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Iyo mukoresha akadege, suzuma neza imbere yuko mufise uburenganzira bwo kubika ireresi hamwe n' impusha canke n' ibindi vyemezo birengako bikenewe.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: kugurukisha i drone impande y' ikibuga c' indege canke hejuru y' umugwi w' abantu ni iciyumviro kibi imisi yose, nubwo bitoba bibujijwe mukarere kanyu.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Mwino misi yacu, urugendo rwo mukirere rutegenywa gake ubwo nyene hakoreshejwe ishirahamwe ryo kwunguruza abantu mukirere hatabanje kuronderwa no kugereranywa ibiciro.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Rimwe na rimwe iguruka rimwe rirashobora kugira ibiciro bitandukanye cane kuhatangarizwa ibiciro hatandukanye kandi ni vyiza kugereranya inyishu z' ubushakashatsi hama mukaraba k'urukuta ngurukana bumenyi rw'ishirahamwe rijejwe ingendo zo mukirere ubwaryo nyene imbere yo kubikisha.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Mugihe ushobora kudakenera viza kungendo ngufi mubihugu bimwe bimwe nk'ingenzi canke kubikorwa, kugendayo nk' umunyeshure wo muma kungu kenshi bisaba kumarayo umwanya muremure gusumba kujayo nk' ingenzi isanzwe.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Mu bisanzwe, kuguma mugihugu icarico cose c' amahanga igihe kirekire bizogusaba kuronka viza imbere y'igihe.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Ama viza y'abanyeshure kenshi afise ibisabwa hamwe n' ibikorwa mugusaba bitandukanye n'ama viza y' ingenzi canke y' akazi.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Mubihugu vyinshi, muzokenera urwete rubaha uruhusha ruva ku kigo mwipfuza kwigako, vyongeye n' icemezo c' ama faranga kugira mwishure ivyo mukenera nimiburi buri umwaka wa mbere w' ivyigwa.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Vugana n'ikigo, cokimwe n'igisata kijejwe abimukira c'igihugu mwipfuza kwigamwo kugira mumenye ibisabwa ido nido.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Kiretse uri umuserukizi, gukorera mumahanga kenshi bisigura ko utegerezwa kuvuga ikori k'umushahara ukorera mugihugu ubayemwo.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Ikori ku mushahara ritunganijwe ugutandukanye mubihugu bitandukanye, hamwe n'urugero n'ibice vy'amakori birahindagurika cane kugihugu kimwe n'ikindi.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Mubihugu bimwe bimwe vyashize hamwe, nka Reta Zunze Ubumwe hamwe na Canada, ikori kumushahara rirakurwako hompi kurwego rw'ishirahamwe no kurwego rwo mukibano, kuburyo urugero n'ibice vy'amakori birashobora guhinduka kuva mukarere ku akandi.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Kuberako isuzumwa ry' inyambukira ridahari canke vyo guhuma amaso iyo mushitse mugihugu canyu c' amavuko, isuzumwa kuri customs rishobora kuba ikibazo.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Gerageza kumenya ivyo mushoboye nivyo mudashobora kuzana hama muvuge icarico cose kitajanye n' amategeko.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Uburyo bworoshe cane bwo gutangura mw'icuruzwa ry'inyandiko zerekeye ingendo ni ukwerekana ubuhinga bwanyu ku rukuta ngurukana bumenyi rwerekeye ingendo rusanzwe ruhari.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Inyuma yo kwisanzura no guhindura hamwe no gukosorera k'ubuhinga ngurukana bumenyi, aho munyuma, urashobora kwubaka urukuta ngurukana bumenyi rwawe.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ugukorera ubushake mugihe uri kurugendo ni inzira nziza yo kugira itandukaniro, ariko si ugutanga gusa.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kubaho no gukorera ubushake mugihugu c' amahanga ni uburyo bwiza bwo kumenya akaranga gatandukanye, ko guhura n' abantu bashasha, bwo kwiga vyinshi kuri wewe, kubona ibintu gushasha mbere no kuronka ubumenyi bushasha.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Gashobora kuba akaryo ko kwongereza ubutunzi bugufasha kumara igihe kirekire ahantu, kubera ko ubuzi bwinshi bw'abakorera bushake butanga aho kuba hamwe no gukingirwa hamwe na buke buhemba agashahara gato.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Aba Vikings bakoresha inzira z' ubwogero z' uburusiya kugira baje Kukiyaga Cirabura hamwe no kukiyaga ca Caspian. Ibice bimwe bimwe vyayo ma barabara nubu birashobora gukoreshwa. Suzuma impusha zidasanzwe zishobora gukenerwa, zishobora kuba zigoye kuronka.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Umuhora White Sea–Baltic uhuza Inyanja ya Arctic Kukiyaga ca Baltic, iciye Kukiyaga Onega, ikiyaga Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, kenshi cane hakoreshejwe inzuzi n' ibiyaga.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Ikiyaga ca Onega naco kirafatanye na Volga, kubwivyo kuva Kukiyaga Caspian uciye m' Uburusiya biracashoboka.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Shira amakenga ko mugihe muzoshika kukivuko ibintu vyose bizoba bitahuritse neza cane. Muzohura n' abandi batwara abantu mubwato kubuntu kandi bazobasangiza amakuru yabo.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Hakuru, muzomanika amatangazo agaragaza ubufasha bwanyu, mwurira uruhome bazirikako ubwato, kwegera abantu bariko baroza amato yabo, mugerageza kumenyana n'abakorera kubwato mu kabare, n'ibindi.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Gerageza kuvugana n'abantu benshi basboboka. Inyuma y'akanya gato, bose bazobamenya hama babavunire akagohe mugihe hari ubwato burondera umuntu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Mwategerezwa guhitamwo mwitonze mw'ihuriro ishirahamwe ryanyu ryo kwiyunguruza mukirere Mukunze Kugurukiramwo.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nubwo ushobora kwiyumvira ko bikuzamwo gukurikira ishirahamwe ryo kwiyunguruza mukirere ukunda kugurukiramwo cane, wobwirizwa kumenya ko uturusho dutangwa tuba kenshi dutandukanye kandi amanota ahabwa ingenzi zikunda gufata ingendo ashobora kuba menshi murindi shirahamwe ryo kwiyunguruza mukirere mw'ihuriro rimwe.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Amashirahamwe yo kwiyunguruza mukirere nka Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways na Turkish Airlines yaramaze kwagura cane aho akorera muri Afirika, kandi agahuza ibisagara bikuru vyinshi vya Afirika ku biciro vyiza gusumvya ayandi mashirahamwe yo kwiyunguruza mukirere y'Iburaya.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines ifise ibibanza 39 iguruka ishikiramwo biri mubihugu 30 vyo muri Afirika mumwaka wa 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Iyo mufise umwanya w' urugendo wongeweko, suzuma ukuntu ibiciro vyose vyo kuja muri afirika bigereranijwe n' ibiciro vyo kuzunguruka isi.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ntimwibagire kwongera ibindi biciro birengako vy'amaviza arengako, amakori yo guhaguruka, ubwiyunguruzi bwo hasi, n' ibindi. kurivyo bibanza vyose hanze ya afirika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Nimba ushaka kuguruka kw'isi yose uciye mu ruhande rw'Amaja Epfo y'isi honyene, amahitamwo y'ingendo n'aho woshikira biraharuye kubera ubuke bw'inzira zica mu mabahari.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Nta shirahamwe ry'ibigo vy'indege gikwiragira amayira y'amabahari yose ukwo ari atatu mu ruhande rw'Amaja Epfo y'isi (na SkyTeam ntifata n'imwe muri izo nzira).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: N'aho biri ukwo, Star Alliance irakwiragira hose uretse mu buseruko bushira ubumanuko bwa bw'ibahari Pasifike kuva i Santiago gushika i Tahiti, narwo akaba ari urugendo rwa LATAM ruhuza isi imwe.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Uru rugendo siryo hitamwo ryonyene ufise mu gihe woba wipfuza kwihoza ibahari ya Pasifike y'amaja Epfo n'inkengera zo mu burengerazuba za Amerika y'epfo. (Raba musi)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Mu 1994, agace ka Nagorno-Karabakh ko mu bwoko bw'abanya Armeniya ko muri Azerbayijani kateye intambara ku ba Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: N'imfashanyo ya Armeniya, repuburika nshasha yarakozwe. N'aho vyari ukwo, nta gihugu cigenga - uretse na Armeniya - cayemera ku mugaragaro.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Impari z'ubuserukizi ku bijanye n'ako karere zibandanya gutoba imigenderanire hagati ya Armeniya na Azerbayijani.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Disirigiti yo ku Mugezi (Grachtengordel: mu ki Dutch) ni yo disirigiti rurangiranwa yo mu kinjana ca 17 ikikuje Binnestad y'i Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Iyo disigiriti yose yagenwe na UNESCO nk'ikibanza Ndangakaranga c'Isi kubera agaciro k'akaranga na kahise haco kadasanzwe.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, gisigura Amatongo Atanu, hagizwe n'utugwati dutanu two ku nkengera z'uruzi dutoduto twa Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso duherereye mu karere ko mu Butaliyano ka Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Twose turanditswe ku rutonde Ndangakaranga rw'Isi rwa UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Mu binjana vyinshi, abantu baratavye ibibanza bitonze muri iyo misozi igoye, ihanamye neza na neza imbere y'ibimanga birabana n'ikiyaga.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Uruhande rumwe mu biharyohora ni ukuba ata mashirahamwe y'ubudandaji ahaboneka. Amayira, gari ya mwuka n'amato bihuza ibigwati, n'imiduga ntishobora kubashikira ivuye inyuma.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Amoko y'igifaransa kivurwa mu Bubiligi no mu bu Swissi biratandukanye gato n'igifaransa kivugwa mu Bufaransa, n'aho bisa bikwiye ku buryo rumwe n'urundi zumvikana.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Mu ruhande rumwe, sisiteme yo guharura mu Bubiligi buvuga igifaransa no bu Buswisi ifise udutandukaniro tumwe tumwe duto dutangukanye n'igifaransa co mu Bufaransa, kandi n'imvugo y'amajambo amwe amwe iratandukanye bukebuke.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Bititawe kuri ivyo, Ababirigi bose bavuga igifaransa n'aba Swisi baba barize igifaransa gisanzwe mw'ishure, rero baba boshobora kugutahura n'aho wokoresha sisiteme yo guharura y'Abafaransa isanzwe.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Mu mpande nyinshi z'isi, kwaya ukuboko ni ikimenyetso c'ubugenzi, gisigura "yambu."
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Ariko, muri Maleziya, basi mu banya Maleziya bo mu turere two mu mitumba, bisigura "ingo hano," co kimwe n'iyo urutoki rw'urukumu rugonze ruraba ku mubiri, ikimenyetso gikoreshwa mu bihugu bimwe bimwe vyo mu burengero, kandi cabwirizwa gukoreshwa kuri iyo nsiguro gusa.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Nk'ukwo nyene, ingenzi y'umwongereza muri Esupanye yoshobora kwihenda ko ukwaya ukuboko harimwo iyo mu kiganza haraba uwukwaya (aho kuraba umuntu ariko arabigirirwa) nk'ikimenyetso co kugaruka.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Indimi z'inyunganizi n'indimi z'incurano canke zidendekeranije zashizweho hagambiriwe kworosha ukuvugana hagati y'abantu basanzwe bogize ingorane mu kuvugana.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Ziratandukanye na lingua francas, izo nazo zikaba ari indimi kama canke zitagoye zica zirengera izindi kubera imvo imwe canke iyindi nk'uburyo bwo kuvugana hagati y'abayaga mu zindi ndimi.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Mu bushuhe bwo ku mutaga, abahatemberera barashobora kubona imirazi ibereka amashusho atari yo y'amazi (canke ibindi bintu).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Ivyo bishobora kuba bibi mu gihe uwuhatembera akwirikiye iyo mirazi, agasesagura inguvu ziwe z'agaciro n'amazi yari asigaye.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: N'ubugararwa bushushe kuruta ubundi burashobora gukanya birenze mw'ijoro. Gukanyirwa ni ingorane ishoboka iyo udafise impuzu zishushe.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Mu ci, na cane cane, uzokenera kumera amagabo wirinda imibu ni wahitamwo kuyerera mw'ishamba ry'imvura.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: N'aho woba uriko utwara umuduga mw'iryo shamba rikanye ryo ku mutuma w'isi, amasegonda make imiryango yuguruye mu giho uriko urinjira mu muduga ni umwanya ukwiye kugira imibu ibe yinjiranye mu muduga nawe.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Akamangu k'inkoko, canke ibicurane vy'ibiguruka mu majambo amenyerewe, gashobora kwandukira inyoni n'ibikoko vyonsa ukwo ari bibiri.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Uturorero duke tudashika igihumbi nitwo tumaze gushikirizwa mu bantu, ariko tumwe muri two twagize ingaruka mbi zikomeye.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Twinshi twari twerekeye abantu bakorera mu nkoko, ariko hariho n'ingorane ku basamarira inyoni.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Nk'uko bimenyerewe muri Norveje hari ama fjord n'imyonga bihanamye bishikana n'ingoga mu biyaya biri hejuru, bigoroye bukebuke canke cane.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ivyo biyaya kenshi bavyita "vidde" bisiguye ikibanza cagutse, cugurutse kitagiramwo ibiti, c'ubwaguke butagira imbibe.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Muri Rogaland no muri Agder kenshi vyitwa "hei" bisigura itongo ritagiramwo ibiti ry'ikirarane kenshi ryiganziwe n'ivyatsi bitukura.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Urubura ntiruguma hamwe, ariko ruguma runyerera ruja mu ntaba z'umusozi. Ibi bizotuma haba imigaga, ibinogo, bishobora kuzibirwa n'ibiraro vy'ibibura.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Impome n'ibisenge vy'imyobo y'ibibura bishobora kurwa kandi imigaga ikazibirwa.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ku nkengera z'ibibura binini ibimanyu binini birameneka bikavako, bikarwa hasi binabaye ibishoboka bigakoroka canke bigatembagarira kure y'inkengera.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Igihe c'ingenzi mu mahuriro yo mu misozi mu bisanzwe gishika kw'isonga mu gihe c'ici ry'Abahindi.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: N'aho biri ukwo, bifise ubwoko butandukanye bw'ubwiza n'ubushuhe mu gihe c'ubukanye, harimwo na henshi muri ivyo bibanza vyo ku musozi haboneka urubura rwinshi hakuguruwa n'ibikorwa nk'ivyo kunyerera ku rubura.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Amashirahamwe y'ivyindege amwe gusa niyo azotanga impozo yo kubura uwawe, iyo nayo ikagabanya gatoya ikiguzi c'ingendo zo ku munota wanyuma ugiye ku maziko.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Amashirahamwe y'ivyindege atanga ivyo harimwo Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa ku ngengo ziwa muri Reta Zunze Umwe canke Canada, na WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Ibihe vyose, utegerezwa kubikisha ikibanza ningoga ukoresheje telefone y'iryo shirahamwe.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
